The proposed method combines the stable policy updates of PPO with an advantage-weighting mechanism inspired by AWAC to emphasize higher-quality actions during training. To encourage cooperation without inter-device communication, a shared global reward aligned with system cost is employed. Extensive simulations demonstrate rapid convergence and significant improvement in overall system cost compared with baselines, e.g., Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) and Deep Q-Network (DQN).
summary_zh: 边云系统中低延迟服务需求增加，部分可观测下的动态任务卸载面临非凸及高维连续空间等挑战。
提出基于AWAC增强PPO的MARL算法，设备无需通信即可通过共享全局奖励实现协同的局部部分卸载。
仿真表明该方法收敛迅速，相比DDPG和DQN基线显著降低了系统总成本。
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted at IEEE GLOBECOM 2026

title: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
title_zh: ROAM-GRPO：通过路由离模方法挖掘增强GRPO的推理多样性
abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of the MATH lvl5 dataset, ROAM-GRPO implementation increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.
summary_zh: SFT结合RLVR训练LLM会导致策略坍缩至低多样性模式，使输出趋同且pass@k准确率停滞或下降。
提出ROAM-GRPO算法，将已解决问题转入离模轨道，由LLM评判验证并自蒸馏新的解题策略至策略中。
在MATH数据集上训练Qwen3.5-2b，显著提升了模型输出的多样性，且困难评估集的pass@16提升4.7%。
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop

title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
title_zh: SpatialMem：基于分层记忆的定量空间推理agent
abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios. In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.
summary_zh: VLM在定量空间推理上受限，现有方法依赖固定工具管线，难以应对多样空间场景。
提出SpatialMem分层记忆框架，用任务记忆编排工具、场景记忆选择工具，并优化轨迹。
构建MetricBench基准，方法在多个基准达SOTA，在MetricBench上较最优VLM提升32%。

title: Ground Truth Bias in AI-Assisted Medical Annotation: A Crossover Study Using an Independent Radiologist Reference Standard
title_zh: AI辅助医学标注中的基准偏差：基于独立放射科医师参考标准的交叉研究
abstract: Behavioural evaluations of artificial-intelligence-assisted annotation score every human decision against a reference standard, so their conclusions inherit that standard's validity. We tested how far conclusions about assistance, reliance and individual differences depend on it. Fifty-one non-expert high-school students annotated 50 knee radiographs for osteoarthritis, with and without a deliberately imperfect classifier, in a crossover design; personality and non-verbal reasoning were also measured. Decisions were scored against the public repository labels and against an independent reference standard from a radiologist panel, which graded 23 of the 50 images as indeterminate. Against the repository labels, assistance raised accuracy from 60.4% to 65.3% (odds ratio 1.23, p=0.002). Against the independent standard, the gain on the 27 determinate images was smaller and not significant in the primary model (78.4% to 80.8%; odds ratio 1.16, p=0.178). The apparent benefit had been concentrated on the indeterminate images and was not significant when those images were assigned to either class. The direction of residual over-reliance depended on how indeterminate cases were handled, and the personality trait most strongly associated with accuracy changed identity and sign between standards. Reliance measures are only as valid as the reference standard that defines when the assistant is right.
summary_zh: AI辅助标注的评估结论依赖于参考标准的有效性，但该标准对辅助效果、依赖性及个体差异的影响尚不明确。
采用交叉设计让51名高中生标注膝关节X线片，对比公开库标签与独立放射科医师小组的参考标准进行评估。
发现辅助带来的准确率提升在独立标准下不显著，且过度依赖方向和相关人格特质均随标准改变，证明依赖性测量的有效性受限于参考标准。

title: From Code Review Comments to Reuse in Production: An Industrial Study of Extracted Rules
title_zh: 从代码审查评论到生产复用：提取规则的工业实证研究
abstract: Much organization-specific code review knowledge remains embedded in comments on individual changes, and recent systems reuse it by turning those comments into rules a language model applies to later changes. Teams must then decide which rules to keep, and the evidence at hand is how often the system's later comments name each rule. Tracing the rules of one such system, Kleene, through 65 days of production use, we found that such a count does not show what a rule contributed. A rule attribution indicates neither whether the source content was preserved nor whether the comment requested a change. Of 56 clauses in 12 rules that later comments named as their reason, 2 were explicit in a source review thread, 38 added conditions to a corresponding passage, and 16 had no passage we could locate; 45 of 79 further comments naming those rules requested no change, 27 of them while stating that the rule applied. On 20 constructed code changes, a reviewer model given only the unedited source thread met the detection criteria on 8 of the 10 that require a report, against 10 of 10 with the extracted rule, a difference whose confidence interval includes zero. Stage counts locate where rules drop out but not why: of 464 rules deployed while the rule-based reviewer subagent ran in their repository, 259 (55.8%) were named, 195 (42.0%) produced a comment that was not withheld, and 94 (20.3%) one with a recorded code change; the largest reduction occurred before any rule was named. Nor did the deployment-time properties we tested settle the choice in advance: retaining the top-ranked half preserved 53.8% of the rules that later produced a non-withheld comment, against 49.2% at random, a difference whose confidence interval includes zero. Judging extracted rules therefore calls for recording each stage separately and comparing each rule against the threads it was extracted from.
summary_zh: 组织特定的代码审查知识常隐含在评论中，现有系统将其转为规则交由语言模型复用，但仅凭规则被引用的次数无法衡量其实际贡献。
通过追踪生产系统Kleene 65天的数据，发现规则归因既不能反映源内容是否被保留，也无法判断评论是否要求代码修改。
实验表明部署时属性与排名均无法提前有效筛选规则，评估提取规则需要超越引用计数的更深入方法。

title: CRAFT: Analog Circuit Design by Reasoning LLM Agents from Pre-Computed Lookup Tables
title_zh: CRAFT：基于推理 LLM Agent 与预计算查找表的模拟电路设计
abstract: Automated analog circuit sizing methods, from black-box optimizers to recent large language model (LLM) agents, typically search the design space with a SPICE simulator in the loop, whereas an experienced designer works out a design by hand analysis. This paper presents CRAFT, a flow in which an LLM agent designs a given topology by calculation, as a designer does, and without an initial sizing. The agent works only through DeX, a service that uses pre-computed lookup tables to provide device characteristics and to solve the whole netlist for its operating point and small-signal response. It thus designs without SPICE, and every final design is verified independently in HSPICE. We test CRAFT on four circuits in a commercial 28 nm process; the largest is a 37-transistor three-stage amplifier with 53 design variables, 20 specifications and 74 saturation constraints. With Claude Opus 5.5, CRAFT meets every specification and constraint in all 20 runs, five per circuit. On that amplifier, with DeX in place of HSPICE and an identical request for both, the same agent passes in 10 of 10 runs instead of 6 of 10 within an hour and is 2.0x faster at the median.
summary_zh: 现有自动化模拟电路尺寸设计方法依赖 SPICE 仿真器循环搜索，而经验丰富的设计师通常通过手工计算完成设计。
本文提出 CRAFT 流程，让 LLM agent 像设计师一样通过计算进行设计，利用预计算查找表服务 DeX 提供器件特性并求解电路工作点。
在 28nm 工艺的四个电路上测试，CRAFT 在所有运行中均满足规格与约束；相比直接使用 HSPICE，该方法通过率更高且速度提升 2.0 倍。

title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
title_zh: 面向Agent负载的LLM推理平台验证驱动部署
abstract: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. A code-coverage analysis of vLLM further shows that the evaluated live, replayed, and synthetic workloads are complementary in this configuration: each exercises Python serving paths not reached in the measured runs of the others. In a case study rolling out four large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on llm-d, experiments show that the target models reached about half the optimal concurrency, and correspondingly about 60% of the throughput, on captured workloads compared with public traces. We open-source the relevant tools and release a trace dataset.
summary_zh: 企业将Agent负载从封闭API转向自建部署，但现有评估工具缺乏准确性，亟需全生命周期验证。
提出端到端评估流水线，实验证明回放捕获的trace能稳定复现原始会话负载，且与真实、合成负载形成互补。
在llm-d上部署MoE模型的案例表明，目标模型在捕获负载下仅达到约最优并发的一半及60%的吞吐量。

title: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
title_zh: 医疗LLM的可验证逻辑：临床推理优化与神经符号 grounding 综述
abstract: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge, and they report large gains on the safety measures they use. These results come from single studies, mostly in simulated or small-sample settings, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines. Process reward models remain bounded by the statistics of their training data. We propose a conceptual framework that maps each agentic failure mode to a symbolic intervention point, and we argue that clinical AI safety depends substantially on system architecture. Because current regulation emphasizes performance and does not require verification of reasoning steps, we argue that responsible certification should also audit reasoning trajectories alongside accuracy on static benchmarks.
summary_zh: 临床LLM常因无效推理产生幻觉，而传统静态评估仅看最终答案，难以察觉此类因果谬误与虚假捷径。
本文梳理了agent幻觉级联、过程奖励模型及神经符号 grounding 等范式，提出将agent失效模式映射至符号干预点的概念框架。
研究表明系统架构对临床AI安全至关重要，呼吁监管机构在静态基准外，增加对推理轨迹的审计与认证。

title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization
title_zh: Meta-RTL：用于RTL优化的智能体框架进化方法
abstract: Large language models enable agents to optimize RTL using EDA feedback, yet their executable search procedures remain largely hand- engineered. We present Meta-RTL, an EDA-grounded framework that evolves RTL optimization harnesses from a minimal loop while keeping the optimization model, EDA flow, and per-design budgets fixed. Compared with Dr. RTL, Meta-RTL* reduces aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 7.8%/11.0% across 20 development designs, with area reductions on 70% of them. Without further evolution, Meta-RTL* transfers to 10 unseen IC-RTL designs, reducing aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 20.5%/14.0% and total synthesized area by 12.6%. We further characterize three search mechanisms in the evolved harness and assess their contributions through ablations and a case study.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent优化RTL的搜索流程多为人工设计，限制了优化效果。
提出Meta-RTL框架，在固定模型、EDA流程和预算下，从最小循环进化优化框架。
相比基线显著减少违例并缩减面积，且能泛化至未见设计，还通过消融分析验证了机制贡献。

title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
title_zh: EvoMem：面向长视频记忆的自进化检索技能agent
abstract: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.
summary_zh: 现有长视频检索依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏时间状态控制，易返回碎片化证据。EvoMem构建分层时间索引记忆，将证据统一对齐至视频时间轴。
针对长视频问答中的检索目标不清等错误，EvoMem引入检索技能提供过程级指导，根据当前证据状态动态调整记忆访问与时间范围。
受强化学习启发，将技能进化建模为奖励引导的策略改进过程，无需更新参数即可筛选有效技能。实验表明其平均准确率达60.1%。

title: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
title_zh: WHU-Road3D：面向细粒度路面测绘的数据集与基准
abstract: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}.
summary_zh: 现有道路要素提取数据集在语义丰富度、数据模态多样性和场景复杂性上存在不足，难以满足高精地图等应用需求。
构建WHU-Road3D大规模多模态数据集，提供约100公里道路的MLS点云、全景图像及15类要素的矢量与实例标注。
该数据集是首个涵盖全面路面要素的多模态数据集，可推动实例分割、全要素提取及道路拓扑推理等前沿研究。

title: Generalist Meets Specialists: An Evolving Multimodal Agent with Persistent Tool Orchestration for Traffic Scenario Understanding
title_zh: 面向交通场景理解的通专结合多模态Agent
abstract: Traffic scenario understanding requires combining fine-grained visual evidence with spatial and temporal reasoning. Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can use specialized perception tools, but effective collaboration faces two challenges: terminal rewards provide limited guidance for intermediate decisions and error recovery, while repeated planning adds unnecessary cost across similar tasks. Echoing the fast-slow dichotomy of human cognition, we propose StarTV-Agent, which combines policy learning with experience evolution to support adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience when possible. During training, Role-Sensitive Process Optimization (RSPO) combines process advantages with terminal advantages, while Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning (WDL) provides validated teacher demonstrations targeting the student's weak questions. During inference, Lightweight Adaptive Workflow Reuse (LAWR) enables a fast path by selecting suitable workflows and binding task-specific arguments and resource references, while a slow ReAct-based path handles tasks without suitable workflows. We further design label-free feedback based on execution completion, workflow adoption, and cost savings to guide workflow reuse and memory updates. Across three challenging benchmarks, StarTV-Agent achieves up to 8.0% relative performance improvement, while reducing token consumption by up to 52.1%.
summary_zh: 针对交通场景理解中VLM工具协作的中间决策指导不足与重复规划开销大问题，提出StarTV-Agent。
训练阶段结合过程与终端优势优化及弱点驱动示范学习，推理阶段采用自适应工作流复用与ReAct双路径。
在三个基准测试中，该方法最高提升8.0%相对性能，并减少52.1%的token消耗。

title: Thinking in Streams: Proactive Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 流式视频中的主动空间推理与视觉语言模型
abstract: Recognizing when a requested spatial condition holds in streaming video can require maintaining and updating spatial knowledge across changing viewpoints. We study this capability through proactive spatial reasoning, where a model receives a query in advance and determines whether and when to respond as the stream unfolds. We introduce ProSpace-Bench, comprising nine tasks across object, camera, and scene reasoning, and ProSpace-Train for supervised training. To support spatial decisions, we propose ProSpace-VLM, which injects explicit geometric encodings estimated causally from incoming frames into intermediate VLM layers, using the existing KV cache as spatial memory and spatial token selection for efficient streaming. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between VLMs and humans, while ProSpace-VLM improves timely responses and correct abstention over fine-tuned baselines. Analyses examine how ProSpace-VLM represents previously observed spatial information across changing viewpoints.
summary_zh: 流式视频的空间条件判断需跨视角维护知识，现有VLM在此主动空间推理任务上存在不足。
构建ProSpace-Bench基准与训练集，提出ProSpace-VLM，将因果估计的几何编码注入VLM层，并利用KV缓存与空间token选择实现高效流式处理。
实验表明该方法提升了及时响应与正确弃答能力，缩小了VLM与人类在空间推理上的差距。

title: HALTT: A HAte Lexicon Through Time
title_zh: HALTT：历时仇恨词汇词典构建与分析框架
abstract: Automated hate speech detection degrades over time as everyday vocabulary is weaponized into covert slurs while retaining original benign meanings (polysemy retention). Existing lexical semantic change detection (LSCD) frameworks struggle with this phenomenon due to a lack of standardized, sense-delineated diachronic resources. We propose a multi-stage framework to construct and validate a diachronic lexicon of semantically shifted hate speech terms. Filtering > 20,000 candidates, our pipeline combines historical (1770-1964) and modern (2001-2024) corpus frequency grounding, masked definition-level scoring to mitigate LLM temporal bias, and a dual-persona reasoning prompt paradigm. We release HALTT, a grounded lexicon of 19 polysemous terms with literal and derogatory senses, analyze shift typologies, and establish evaluation protocols for downstream diachronic benchmarking.
summary_zh: 仇恨检测随日常词汇被武器化为隐蔽贬义词而退化，现有 LSCD 框架因缺乏历时资源难以应对。
提出多阶段框架，结合历史与现代语料频率、掩码定义评分及双人格推理提示，构建历时仇恨词典。
发布含 19 个多义词的 HALTT 词典，分析语义转变类型并建立下游历时基准评估协议。

title: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
title_zh: HabitusMem：面向LLM Agent用户偏好演化的信念记忆
abstract: Personalized LLM agents must act on a user's current preferences, which change across interactions and are rarely stated in full. Existing memory systems store and retrieve content from the interaction history and leave the agent to work out which preferences still hold and where they apply. Such content does not indicate whether a preference is still current or where it applies, so agents often act on outdated or misapplied preferences. We instead treat memory as the assistant's belief about the user. Following Bourdieu's account of habitus as durable but revisable dispositions, we model the user as a latent preference state that every interaction, including the current request, both reveals and updates. The belief summarizes what the history supports about this state, and memory consists of the individual beliefs that bear on the agent's current decision, each with its evidence, scope, and status. We implement this view in HabitusMem, a trained writer that states these beliefs as text records for a frozen agent. Across two agent families, HabitusMem achieves the best results among memory systems on both PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0. Controlled analyses show that learned request conditioning drives the answering gain, while auxiliary training tasks improve tool use.
summary_zh: 现有记忆系统无法判断偏好是否过期或适用场景，导致Agent误用过时偏好。
将记忆建模为Agent对用户的信念，记录偏好的证据、范围与状态以支持当前决策。
训练HabitusMem生成文本信念记录，在两个基准测试中取得最佳效果。

title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
title_zh: EgoWitness：第一视角视频的实例级空间记忆与推理基准
abstract: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.
summary_zh: 现有长视频基准缺乏对多模态模型实例级空间记忆的测试，无法评估其回忆物体何时何地被谁看到的能力。
提出EgoWitness基准，包含8453个问题，覆盖七项能力；测试发现十二个VLM在识别谁最后看到物体上准确率均低于35%。
提出EgoClue空间记忆agent，结合SFT与GRPO两阶段训练，将准确率提升至72.65%，并在新环境中达到80.56%。
comment: 43 pages, including supplementary material. Zhengru Fang and Zehao Liu contributed equally. Project page: https://egowitness.github.io/ ; Code: https://github.com/egowitness/EgoWitness

title: Whose Risks Count? What 1,901 AI Incidents Reveal About Corporate Disclosures
title_zh: 1901起AI事件揭示企业披露中的风险盲区
abstract: AI systems can harm people, yet the AI actors that provide or deploy them are rarely obliged to disclose these risks. US securities regulation is an exception. Companies registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) must disclose their material risks, including those of their AI systems, in filings that carry liability for misstatement. Materiality, however, is defined by what a reasonable investor would consider important, so harms to third parties enter disclosure only insofar as they become financial risks for the company. We test whether AI harms do so by matching 9,001 AI incidents to 18,229 SEC filings of 328 AI actors by risk type. Of the 1,901 incidents with filings before and after them, half belong to a risk type that the AI actor never disclosed, and this share varies with the kind of harm. Filings disclose the risk types of 67\% of system failures but only 2\% of social system harms, and AI actors themselves report fewer than 2\% of incidents. Securities disclosure thus records the risks that AI actors face rather than the harms that people subject to AI bear. Public authorities that hold AI actors accountable for such harms could make them financially material. We release DISC, the Disclosure--Incident Securities Corpus, to support this work.
summary_zh: AI系统常造成第三方伤害，但企业通常无义务披露，SEC证券披露仅在伤害构成企业财务风险时才纳入。
研究将9001起AI事件与328家企业的SEC文件匹配，发现半数事件风险未被披露，且不同伤害类型披露率差异巨大。
证券披露主要反映企业面临的财务风险而非AI受害者承受的伤害，监管机构若追究责任可使这些伤害具有财务重要性。

title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
title_zh: 基于智能体证据管理的医学视觉语言模型
abstract: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlighting a relevant region can expose diagnostic evidence the model previously missed, but the added visual cue can also induce incorrect associations. As a result, even a ground-truth mask can correct some answers while turning initially correct ones into incorrect ones. Together, these findings show that acquiring the right mask is not enough. An agent must also decide how to present the evidence and whether it should change the answer. We therefore introduce TUNE (Tool Use is Not Enough), an evidence-management harness that explicitly manages what evidence to acquire, how to present it, and whether to accept the resulting answer update. Across three public medical VQA benchmarks, evidence management improves the fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B backbone's mean accuracy by 4.0 percentage points. Full TUNE improves over direct tool use by 9.1 points on average across seven benchmarks and achieves competitive results against existing medical VLMs and agents.
summary_zh: 现有医学视觉问答基准无法单独评估证据使用效果，作者构建了包含2.5K样本的Mask-Evidence MedVQA基准。
研究发现获取正确掩码不足以保证效果，证据呈现方式会影响模型行为，且掩码会引入证据权衡问题。
提出证据管理框架TUNE，显式管理证据获取、呈现及答案更新，在多个基准上显著提升模型准确率。
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Qiming Huang, Hanze Dong, and Jipeng Zhang contributed equally

title: Software-Defined Internet Integration of Satellite Networks (SDISN)
title_zh: 卫星网络的软件定义互联网融合架构
abstract: This paper proposes SDISN, a software-defined Internet integration of satellite networks. It facilitates the transmission of IP traffic from user terminals (UTs) or Internet nodes over a satellite network with inter-satellite links (ISLs). Gateways (GWs) together with Points of Presence (PoPs) support the transition between the satellite network and the Internet. UTs and GWs connect to the satellite network via serving satellites (SrvSats). As the satellites orbit the Earth at high speed, UTs and GWs frequently change their SrvSats. This causes frequent changes to their reachability, which poses a major challenge for integration. In the proposed solution, GWs and SrvSats encapsulate traffic with forwarding information so that the traffic can be carried over the satellite network towards appropriate SrvSats of UTs or GWs. The forwarding information on the encapsulating nodes is continuously updated by a controller to reflect changed SrvSats and possibly changed topology of the satellite network. Design goals for the proposed architecture were low complexity on satellites, high ability for traffic engineering, and keeping UTs out of the routing system for security and compatibility reasons. UTs may have increased security requirements (ISRs) such that their traffic should be carried within the constellation to avoid non-trusted terrestrial infrastructure. Extensions are proposed to support such ISRs. UTs may obtain either dynamic IP addresses from a nearby GW/PoP wherever they roam or they may obtain static IP addresses from a fixed Home GW/PoP. In the latter case, triangle routing via the Home GW occurs when the UT roams away from the Home GW. As this adds latency to the communication, we investigate architectural extensions for latency reduction. In addition, we show how traffic engineering can be performed in such an architecture with the help of alternate GWs and SrvSats.
summary_zh: 卫星高速运动导致终端与网关服务卫星频繁切换，引发可达性变化，阻碍卫星网络与互联网融合。
提出SDISN架构，由控制器动态更新转发信息，网关与服务卫星封装流量，实现IP报文在星间链路传输。
该架构降低卫星复杂度并提升流量工程能力，支持终端安全需求与移动IP分配，并优化漫游三角路由延迟。

title: RAVEN: A Self-RAG Based Agent for Threat Classification and Response
title_zh: 基于 Self-RAG 的安全威胁分类与响应 agent RAVEN
abstract: Security event analysis in large enterprises can be overwhelming, as each alert typically requires manual in- spection by human operators. This process is time-consuming and prone to inconsistencies, especially in high-volume Secu- rity Operations Center (SOC) environments. In this work- in-progress paper, we present RAVEN: Retrieval-Augmented Vulnerability & Event aNalysis, an agentic framework designed to support SOC analysts by automating the initial stages of alert investigation. The proposed system leverages a Self- Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Generation-based approach to provide an initial classification of security events and enables interactive refinement through analyst-in-the-loop queries. Un- like traditional approaches that rely on generic mitigation strategies, RAVEN generates context-aware remediation sug- gestions by incorporating knowledge of the target enterprise infrastructure. We implement an early-stage prototype and report preliminary results on three balanced test sets of 400 curated web payloads each (SQLi, XSS, SSTI) and a qualitative case study of mitigation generation; an evaluation on IDS- generated alerts and a user study are ongoing and outlined as remaining work.
summary_zh: 企业 SOC 环境中安全告警依赖人工排查，耗时且易出现不一致问题。
提出 RAVEN 框架，利用 Self-RAG 方法自动分类安全事件，并支持分析师交互式优化查询。
结合企业基础设施知识生成上下文感知的缓解建议，初步测试验证了其分类与缓解生成能力。

title: ALIoTh: Orchestrating Multi-Agent LLMs for Autonomous IoT Penetration Testing
title_zh: ALIoTh：面向物联网自动化渗透测试的多智能体LLM编排框架
abstract: Penetration testing in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, especially those composed of various different devices, e.g., smart plugs, smart cameras, and smart doors, presents great challenges across the phases of information gathering, attack surface enumeration, privilege escalation, and lateral movement. This paper introduces ALIoTh, a multi-agent, workflow-driven penetration testing framework that integrates Large Language Models agents within a Self-Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Self-RAG) architecture to autonomously identify and exploit vulnerabilities in IoT and Industrial-IoT (IIoT) environments. By leveraging state-of-the-art language models and orchestrating specialized agents via the LangGraph framework, ALIoTh dynamically plans and executes a full-spectrum offensive pipeline. This includes network, devices, and service enumeration, vulnerability assessment, payload generation, reverse shell deployment, and privilege escalation on each device. The Self-RAG mechanism equips expert agents with contextual access to IoT security knowledge, e.g., related documentation, tool manuals, and known attack techniques, enhancing their reasoning capabilities in scenarios involving multiple device exploitation and group policy manipulation.
summary_zh: 物联网环境设备多样，导致信息收集、攻击面枚举、提权和横向移动等渗透测试阶段面临巨大挑战。
提出多智能体框架ALIoTh，结合Self-RAG架构与LangGraph编排专家智能体，动态规划并执行全谱系攻击流程。
Self-RAG机制为智能体提供IoT安全知识上下文，增强了多设备利用与组策略操控等场景下的推理能力。

title: Personalized Privacy-Aware MARL Offloading in the Edge-Cloud Continuum
title_zh: 边缘云连续体中个性化隐私感知的MARL任务卸载
abstract: Task offloading in End-Edge-Cloud computing enables resource-constrained User Devices (UDs) to execute computation-intensive applications with reduced latency and energy consumption. However, existing task offloading schemes generally overlook the heterogeneous privacy requirements of users, leading to inefficient privacy-aware offloading decisions. In this paper, we propose a personalized privacy-aware task offloading framework, where the privacy requirement of each task is quantified through a User-Centric Privacy (UCP) model that considers task sensitivity, user privacy preferences, and task urgency. The task offloading problem is formulated as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) to jointly optimize the offloading ratio and the target computing server while minimizing the long-term system cost under latency, energy, and privacy constraints. To efficiently solve the resulting high-dimensional continuous optimization problem, we develop an Advantage-Weighted Actor-Critic (AWAC)-enhanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithm under the Centralized Training and Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves lower average system cost, lower energy consumption, and higher task success rate than representative baselines under diverse privacy requirements.
summary_zh: 现有任务卸载方案忽略了用户异构的隐私需求，导致隐私感知卸载决策低效。
提出个性化隐私感知卸载框架，结合UCP模型量化隐私需求，并将其建模为MDP以联合优化卸载比例与目标服务器。
设计基于AWAC增强PPO的MARL算法求解，仿真表明该框架有效降低系统成本与能耗，并提升任务成功率。
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for presentation at IEEE CloudNet 2026

title: When Safety Rationales Hallucinate: Diagnosing and Grounding Multimodal Safety Guards
title_zh: 多模态安全护栏中的理由幻觉诊断与缓解
abstract: Multimodal safety guards increasingly generate rationales alongside safety predictions, yet whether these rationales are reliable remains largely unexplored. We systematically study *rationale hallucination* from two perspectives: visual rationale hallucination, where rationales contain unsupported visual facts, and safety attribution hallucination, where grounded content is assigned an incorrect safety interpretation. Across rationale-generation methods, multiple vision-language backbones, and safety datasets, we find that rationale hallucination is widespread and does not consistently diminish with higher classification accuracy or increased model scale. Further analysis of the Think-with-Image paradigm shows that hallucination is concentrated in fine-grained attributes and relations, while visual tools are often invoked infrequently or without sufficient spatial focus. Based on these findings, we propose *Tool-Contrastive Grounding Reinforcement Learning* (TCG-RL), which rewards tool use only when it improves rationale grounding over a tool-free reference. TCG-RL substantially reduces rationale hallucination while maintaining competitive safety prediction performance. By revealing the gap between prediction correctness and rationale reliability, our study motivates a shift in multimodal safety guarding from outcome-only evaluation toward safety decisions that are both accurate and verifiably grounded.
summary_zh: 多模态安全护栏生成的解释理由存在视觉事实无支撑与安全归因错误等幻觉问题，且幻觉现象普遍存在，不随分类准确率或模型规模提升而减少。
分析发现幻觉集中于细粒度属性与关系，且视觉工具调用频率低或空间聚焦不足，为此提出TCG-RL方法，仅在工具能改善无工具基准的解释时给予奖励。
TCG-RL大幅减少了理由幻觉并保持安全预测性能，促使多模态安全评估从仅看结果转向准确且可验证的决策。

title: RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models
title_zh: RouteVerify：面向MoE模型步骤级验证的路由干预研究
abstract: Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correctness. We report four linked results. First, probes on router logits separate correct from erroneous steps in eight checkpoints (AUROC 0.80-0.88). Second, replacing router logits across all routed layers changes the judgment in all nine checkpoints, and by more than a norm-matched random replacement. Third, this change rarely depends on whether the source step is correct. At one layer, routing from erroneous steps and from correct steps produces indistinguishable margins in all nine checkpoints. Under all-layer routing, their difference is resolved and positive in only one. Fourth, the same difference is positive for local residual replacements in eight of nine checkpoints, so the measure does detect such dependence where it exists. Correctness is therefore readable from routing, and routing replacements move the judgment, but the movement rarely follows correctness.
summary_zh: 现有MoE模型的路由状态能否区分正确与错误推理步骤尚需验证，研究者提出RouteVerify方法，通过替换不同接口的内部激活进行受控干预实验。
探针测试表明路由logits能有效区分步骤正误，且全层路由替换会显著改变模型验证判断，超出随机基线水平。
然而判断变化很少依赖源步骤正确性，局部残差替换则能检测到这种依赖，说明路由可读出正确性但机制更复杂。

title: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
title_zh: 纳米结构热传输的智能成像技术
abstract: The ability to measure thermal properties and visualize heat transport processes with high spatial resolution is becoming increasingly important for materials discovery, next-generation electronics, and advanced manufacturing. As critical dimensions and architectures of novel materials and high performance electronics shrink and become more heterogeneous, thermal transport is no longer governed by bulk material properties alone, but by local variations in microstructure, such as interfaces and defects, while the operating conditions can also play a role. With the development of non-contact pump-probe thermoreflectance techniques, specific heat, thermal conductivity, and interface conductance can be mapped either through wide-field thermos-reflectance images or by scanning technique. However, key challenges remain such as the balance between imaging throughput and measurement accuracy, the extraction of multiple parameters with high confidence, and non-intrusive subsurface characterization, etc. This Review highlights recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)-assistance in high-throughput data processing, visualizing interfacial thermal transport, and nonintrusive subsurface analysis, and offers outlooks for future research directions such as spectral mapping of heat carriers, three-dimensional property mapping, and AI-agentic experimental designs. We anticipate this Review will motivate future efforts in combining AI with experimental techniques to achieve unprecedented capabilities for thermal characterization of nanoscale materials and device characterization, facilitating materials discovery and electronics revolution.
summary_zh: 纳米材料与电子器件尺寸缩小且趋于异构，热传输受微观局部特征影响，传统测量难以兼顾通量与精度并实现高置信参数提取
本文综述AI辅助的高通量数据处理、界面热传输可视化及无损伤亚表面分析等进展，探讨热载流子光谱成像与AI-agentic实验设计等方向
结合AI与实验技术有望实现纳米材料热表征能力的突破，推动新材料发现与电子器件革新

title: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 抑制VideoLLM微调背后的文本捷径
abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. However, the VideoLLM also learns to answer from textual regularities of its training data, a shortcut that bypasses the video. The regularities behind the shortcut are hard to define at the data level, and the shortcut forms regardless of training epoch, data size, or backbone. The shortcut is hidden behind a rise in accuracy within the training distribution, yet it is not required for the rise and even costs SFT the gain the video offers under distribution shift. We therefore propose Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection (VETO), which intervenes on the fine-tuning update where the shortcut is written rather than on the data. VETO calibrates the subspace that the text alone occupies in the activations of the base model and projects the update onto its orthogonal complement. The VideoLLM is thus left to ground its answer in the full input, with the shortcut suppressed as it forms and never defined. Across seven VideoLLMs, VETO preserves the gain of SFT on the training distribution and suppresses the shortcut. On six benchmarks under shift it gains more than SFT and answers from the full input rather than the shortcut. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/VETO.
summary_zh: VideoLLM在SFT时会利用文本规律走捷径绕过视频，导致分布偏移时性能下降。
提出VETO方法，在微调更新时投影到文本子空间的正交补空间，抑制捷径形成。
实验表明VETO在训练分布上保持增益，在分布偏移下优于SFT并基于完整输入回答。

title: Plane curves attaining the Dimca-Sernesi bound and Jacobian syzygies of pencil-type curves
title_zh: 达到Dimca-Sernesi界的平面曲线与铅笔型曲线的Jacobian合系
abstract:
For a reduced plane curve $C:f=0$ of degree $d$ with only weighted homogeneous singularities, Dimca and Sernesi proved that the minimal degree of a Jacobian relation satisfies $\mathrm{mdr}(f)\geq α_C\, d-2$, where $α_C$ is the minimal Arnold exponent of the singularities of $C$. We call $C$ DS-extremal (Dimca-Sernesi extremal) when equality holds. We show that curves of pencil type $f=Φ(g,h)$, in particular curves of $(p,q)$-torus type $g^p+h^q$, are DS-extremal, the minimal syzygy being $
abla g	imes
abla h$. Under a natural transversality assumption we determine the minimal free resolution of the Milnor algebra of such a curve: it depends only on $d$, $\mathrm{deg}\, g$ and $\mathrm{deg}\, h$, and the module of Jacobian syzygies is generated by $
abla g	imes 
abla h$ and the three Koszul syzygies. For irreducible sextics with six cusps we prove that $3\le \mathrm{mdr}(f)\le 4$, that $\mathrm{mdr}(f)=3$ for curves of torus type, and that $\mathrm{mdr}(f)=4$ for the general curve in the component of non-torus sextics containing Oka's curve. Hence Zariski's classical pair is a Ziegler pair detected by $\mathrm{mdr}$, and the reason is the extremality of the torus member. We conjecture that every DS-extremal curve is of pencil type and support this by the nodal case and by computations.
summary_zh: 针对加权齐次奇点平面曲线的Jacobian关系最小次数下界问题，定义了DS-极值曲线，并证明铅笔型曲线（含环面型）满足该等式。
在横截性假设下，确定了此类曲线Milnor代数的极小自由分解，其Jacobian合系模由特定合系与Koszul合系生成。
针对含六个尖点的不可约六次曲线，证明了其最小次数范围，并指出Zariski经典对是极小次数可区分的Ziegler对。

title: Closing Performance Gap for Diffusion Language Models under Low Inference Budgets
title_zh: 低推理预算下缩小扩散语言模型性能差距的方法
abstract: Diffusion language models offer an architectural route to low-budget generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, which can reduce the number of sequential decoding steps relative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. However, realizing this advantage at low budgets is challenging, as generation quality often declines when the number of denoising and refinement steps is reduced. Editable diffusion models address this quality loss through post-draft refinement, but useful intermediate results may still be lost before final submission. We introduce CaRR (Commitment-aware Refinement and Recovery), a training-free framework which improves submission quality from a fixed editable checkpoint through updated-context refill and trajectory-based recovery within its existing forward schedule. Token Commitment Remasking (TCR) remasks selected native pure replacements and refills them on the next scheduled edit forward using the updated context. Submission Commitment Recovery (SCR) uses the resulting refinement trajectory to recover supported candidates when the final response does not satisfy task-specific output requirements. Both modules operate within the native mask/edit schedule without additional backbone forwards. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning show consistent gains in average accuracy over native ME-DLM across four inference budgets, with the largest gains under tight budgets. At one-eighth of the full scheduled forward budget, CaRR improves the six-metric average accuracy by 7.44 pp, including gains of 11.37 and 10.05 on MBPP and MBPP+.
summary_zh: 扩散语言模型在低推理预算下减少去噪步数会导致生成质量下降，且中间可用结果易在最终提交前丢失。
提出无训练框架 CaRR，通过更新上下文重填充和基于轨迹的恢复，在原有前向调度内提升提交质量。
在代码生成与数学推理任务中，该方法在多种预算下均提升准确率，在极低预算下六项平均准确率提升7.44个百分点。

title: Characterizing and Detecting Unfaithful Work Reports by Coding Agents
title_zh: 编码Agent不忠实工作报告的特征分析与检测
abstract: Coding agents increasingly carry out long-horizon development tasks, autonomously planning and executing multi-step actions that span files, tools, and sessions. Because developers rarely follow each action, and agents resuming the work depend on records of what was done, the agent's work report often becomes the primary account of what was changed and established. When the report contains false or unsupported claims, it gives recipients false assurance: incomplete work may be accepted without verification, incorrect assumptions about the current state can propagate to later steps and agents, and evaluators that credit stated success may reward the report rather than the work. Yet little is known about what unfaithful reporting looks like in real development work, or how developers and agents handle it once it surfaces. Starting from real developer--agent conversations in SWE-chat, we conduct a systematic mixed-methods analysis of self-admitted unfaithful reports. We identify eleven subtypes in four categories: misreported observations, misattributed evidence, overstated task success, and faulty technical explanations, with overstated task success the most common. Handling these problems involves on average 4.3 further user turns and 12.71 minutes of recorded response and execution time, and users express dissatisfaction more often. Among 435 work reports that we separately sample and annotate, \NaturalPositiveShare{}\% contain at least one unfaithful claim. We also develop FaithDetector, a detector for unfaithful reporting informed by the observed patterns. On naturally sampled reports, FaithDetector attains \NaturalDetectorMacro{}\% macro-F1, about 13 percentage points above the baseline. Together, our findings and FaithDetector provide empirical evidence and an automated method for checking reporting faithfulness, informing agent evaluation and training feedback.
summary_zh: 开发者难以全程监督Agent，不忠实的工作报告会导致未完成工作被误信及错误状态传播。
基于真实对话分析，将不忠实报告分为观察误报、证据错配、夸大成功和技术解释错误四类共十一种子类型。
开发FaithDetector检测器，在自然采样报告上的macro-F1较基线提升约13个百分点。

title: A note on a recent result by Lorist, Meyries, and Veraar, or the counterexample which I missed
title_zh: 关于有界半群无穷小生成元逆的反例构造注记
abstract: Recently Lorist, Meyries, and Veraar showed, among others, that the inverse of an infinitesimal generator of a bounded semigroup on a Hilbert space need not to be an infinitesimal generator of a bounded semigroup. In this note we show that with the ingredients of that paper, the example can be constructed more directly. Furthermore, the author reflects on the reason why he did not construct this a decade ago.
summary_zh: Lorist等人证明了Hilbert空间上有界半群无穷小生成元的逆未必是同类生成元。
本文利用该论文的要素，更直接地构造出上述反例。
作者反思了十年前未能发现此构造的原因。

title: Embodied Human-Data Interaction
title_zh: 具身化人机数据交互
abstract: We propose the concept of human-data interaction (HDI) as the human manipulation, analysis, and sensemaking of large, unstructured, and complex datasets. We then proceed to suggest an embodied approach to HDI to build physical reasoning environments for these difficult and polymorphic tasks. We illustrate our approach with two examples: tangible lenses for visual exploration, and an educational computer game with tangible bricks.
summary_zh: 面对大型复杂数据集的操纵与理解难题，提出人机数据交互（HDI）概念。
为应对多态困难任务，建议采用具身方法构建物理推理环境。
通过可触透镜与实体积木教育游戏两个案例，展示了该具身方法的实际应用。
comment: Published May 2011 at the Embodied Interaction: Theory and Practice in HCI at ACM CHI 2011

title: A closed-loop agentic research environment for MRI development within Siemens IDEA platform
title_zh: 基于Siemens IDEA平台的闭环智能体MRI研究环境
abstract: Motivation: Testing new ideas in MRI can require substantial effort to learn sequence programming and reconstruction tools and to debug implementations before the scientific question can be addressed. Goals: Reduce the implementation and debugging burden of testing MRI ideas while retaining researcher control of scientific decisions. Approach: We developed an environment where LLM agents develop sequences in the native Siemens IDEA platform, evaluate them through Bloch simulation and reconstruction, and further iteratively refine them using scanner feedback. Results: As test cases, the agentic environment was used to implement and validate a GIRF-based gradient-calibration sequence and reconstruction in approximately 4 hours, and to develop and optimize a rapid 3-second multichannel calibration scan in approximately 12 hours of researcher-guided iteration.
summary_zh: MRI新想法的测试需要大量序列编程与调试工作，增加了研究负担。
构建LLM agent环境，在原生Siemens IDEA平台开发序列，结合Bloch仿真与扫描仪反馈进行迭代优化。
该环境在数小时内完成GIRF梯度校准与多通道快速校准扫描的开发，有效降低了实现与调试成本。

title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
title_zh: DACA：面向零样本3D视觉定位的双锚协作智能体
abstract: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
summary_zh: 现有3D视觉定位采用单向流水线架构，分离语义理解与几何重建，易导致误差累积且无法自主恢复失败。
提出双锚协作智能体DACA，通过双向交换语义与几何特征信息，自主决策感知动作步骤以形成闭环优化。
在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上实现零样本Acc@0.25分别达73.6%和70.4%，大幅超越现有零样本方法。

title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
title_zh: STARK：面向个性化Agent的双图长期记忆架构
abstract: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.
summary_zh: 现有Agent长期记忆仅记录事件本身，缺乏对用户行为模式背后原因的推理，难以支撑深度个性化。
提出双图记忆架构STARK，将事件作为边连接行为洞察节点，直接检索行为知识并支持跨用户知识迁移。
在LongMemEval等基准上显著优于现有方法，跨用户迁移有效提升了冷启动用户的生成质量与评估指标。

title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
title_zh: 超越实体识别：以视觉为中心的知识视觉问答
abstract: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/VC-VQA.
summary_zh: 现有基准多将视觉信息视为实体识别并依赖文本外部知识，难以评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的细粒度视觉知识获取与复杂多阶段推理能力。
提出 VC-VQA 基准，要求模型检索外部视觉证据、识别检索前视觉线索，并对内部图像进行知识定位、验证或匹配，同时构建了可控的多模态知识库。
对 21 个 MLLM 的评估表明，当前模型在视觉中心知识推理上仍有困难，细粒度视觉知识获取是主要瓶颈，而 agentic 检索凸显了多步规划与跨模态知识整合的价值。

title: Efficient Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language Model via Dynamics-Aware Quantization and Distillation
title_zh: 基于动态感知量化与蒸馏的视觉语言模型高效隐式推理
abstract: Efficient chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) requires reducing both intermediate reasoning steps and their execution cost. Latent CoT methods compress textual rationales into continuous thoughts, yet their full-precision (FP) models retain substantial storage and computation costs. Lowering numerical precision could reduce these remaining costs, yet direct quantization severely degrades reasoning accuracy, particularly with 4-bit weights and activations. Operator and perturbation analyses reveal key sensitivity and direction-dependent predictive effects of continuous-thought errors, motivating preservation of information retrieval and subsequent reasoning beyond reconstruction accuracy. We therefore introduce QL-VLM, a dynamics-aware Quantization framework for efficient Latent reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). First, Dynamics-Guided Quantization (DGQ) uses nonuniform codebooks that preserve rotary-key structure, mitigating quantization-induced distortion in vision-language information retrieval. Second, Dynamics-Preserving Distillation (DPD) aligns continuous thoughts, latent-query readouts, and predictions with a full-precision teacher, maintaining predictive consistency through subsequent low-precision reasoning. On ScienceQA-IMG with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, 4-bit QL-VLM achieves 90.43% accuracy and improves baseline by 40.33%, with 16.64x fewer bit-operations and 6.40x lower measured latency than explicit CoT.
summary_zh: VLM的隐式CoT方法在全精度下仍存高存储与计算开销，直接4-bit量化会严重损害推理准确率。
提出QL-VLM框架，通过非均匀码本保持旋转键结构并利用全精度教师模型进行蒸馏，对齐连续思维与预测。
在ScienceQA-IMG上，4-bit量化模型准确率达90.43%，大幅提升基线，且显著降低计算量与延迟。

title: GRODE-RTL: Source-Mapped Dependency Views for LLM-Based RTL Repair
title_zh: GRODE-RTL：面向LLM的RTL修复源码映射依赖视图
abstract: Large Language Models show great potential for automated Register-Transfer Level repair, yet they struggle with non-local faults where root causes and failing outputs reside far apart in source code. Treating RTL as a flat token sequence obscures hardware dataflows, whereas exposing complete synthesized graphs overwhelms the model with fine-grained metadata. To resolve this representation dilemma, we propose GRODE-RTL, an anchor-centric representation that extracts the single-clock-stage fan-in cone of a suspect register from the netlist, maps netlist nodes back to editable source lines, and organizes them into a compact hop-partitioned dependency view. By prioritizing direct drivers and folding distant hops, GRODE-RTL guides standard tool-using agents without exposing ground-truth hints or oracle feedback. We evaluate GRODE-RTL across 30 formally validated non-local faults using three LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3) alongside a controlled six-configuration ablation study. GRODE-RTL improves pass@1 over source-level exploration by 16.7% on DeepSeek, by 26.7% on GLM-5.2, and by 20.0% on MiniMax-M3, with consistent gains on the hard-to-retrieve far-distance and indirect-anchor subsets of all three models. Our controls isolate structural relevance from generic context expansion, proving that selective dependency organization rather than full graph exposure is key to effective RTL repair.
summary_zh: LLM在RTL修复中难以处理根因与报错相距较远的非局部故障，且扁平序列与完整综合图均存在表示局限。
提出GRODE-RTL，提取可疑寄存器单时钟扇入锥并映射至源码，构建紧凑的跳数分区依赖视图以引导agent。
在30个故障的评估中，该方法显著提升多模型pass@1指标，证明选择性依赖组织优于全图暴露。
消融实验表明，选择性依赖组织而非通用上下文扩展是提升RTL修复效果的关键。

title: A$^2$-VLA: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Policies to New Tools through Agentic Affordance Discovery
title_zh: A²-VLA：通过具身智能体可供性发现实现VLA策略的工具自适应
abstract: Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes. Validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools. Finally, A$^2$-VLA uses encoded functional-region features as conditioning inputs to a $π_{0.5}$ backbone during training and inference. Evaluation examines affordance reliability in reconstructed scenes and real-robot task success on unseen tools. Our method achieves 86.1% success in simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting based on affordances. On three real-robot tool-use tasks, A$^2$-VLA improves task success by 30.7 percentage points over $π_{0.5}$.
summary_zh: 跨工具迁移操作技能面临难以发现并验证不同工具间共同可供性的问题。
提出A²-VLA框架，结合具身智能体与VLA策略，将可供性作为假设在仿真中自主构建、测试与修正。
实验表明该方法在仿真跨工具轨迹重定向成功率达86.1%，在真实机器人任务上较π0.5提升30.7个百分点。

title: DARSY: A Tool for Data-Driven Abstraction and Policy Synthesis for Stochastic Systems with Unknown Dynamics
title_zh: DARSY：未知动态随机系统的数据驱动抽象与策略合成工具
abstract: This paper presents DARSY: a software tool for abstraction-based verification and policy synthesis in discrete-time stochastic control systems with unknown dynamics and noise distributions. DARSY requires only a simulator of the system and a Lipschitz bound on its dynamics, and needs no knowledge of dynamics or noise distributions. The tool is fully automated and constructs a finite interval Markov decision process (IMDP) abstraction from sampled transitions, whose probability intervals are obtained via statistical techniques and Lipschitz reasoning. Robust dynamic programming on this IMDP then yields a policy together with a lower bound on the probability that the unknown system satisfies a desired specification. This lower bound holds with a user-specified confidence; that is, it is probably approximately correct (PAC). The tool is implemented in Python and supports general Lipschitz-continuous system dynamics and specifications expressed in syntactically co-safe LTL (scLTL), which includes reach-avoid and finite-horizon safety specifications as special cases. Beyond standard IMDPs, DARSY implements a two-layer IMDP (2IMDP) abstraction that also bounds the probability of transitioning to aggregated state blocks, yielding smaller abstraction errors than IMDP abstractions and, as a result, tighter satisfaction guarantees. We demonstrate DARSY's broad applicability across a variety of benchmarks and specifications.
summary_zh: 针对动态与噪声分布未知的离散时间随机控制系统，提出仅需系统模拟器和 Lipschitz 界的自动化验证与策略合成工具 DARSY。
方法是通过采样转移构建有限区间马尔可夫决策过程（IMDP）抽象，结合统计技术与 Lipschitz 推理获取概率区间，再进行鲁棒动态规划。
该工具支持 scLTL 规范，并实现两层 IMDP 抽象以减小误差，在多种基准测试中验证了其广泛适用性，且提供 PAC 满足概率下界。
comment: The tool DARSY and all benchmarks are available at https://github.com/tbadings/darsy
tags: 区间马尔可夫决策过程

title: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
title_zh: MatVerse：面向材料科学的基础模型
abstract: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering, and retrieval-based multimodal data construction. We evaluate MatVerse on three representative materials-science benchmarks: our human-calibrated OmniMatBench, MatSciBench, and MaCBench. Results demonstrate consistent improvements after materials-specific post-training over the base model on all three benchmarks, alongside improved inference efficiency on calculation-intensive problems. These results show that targeted domain-specific post-training can effectively enhance scientific reasoning, materials knowledge understanding, and multimodal scientific capabilities of foundation models. MatVerse provides a unified language-and-vision interface for materials science and serves as a foundation for future AI-assisted materials research workflows.
summary_zh: 材料科学数据高度异构，构建能理解多模态材料信息并进行推理的通用基础模型仍具挑战。
基于 Intern-S2-Preview 构建 MatVerse，通过大规模领域后训练与统一数据构建管线提升领域适应能力。
在三个材料科学基准上均取得性能提升并改善推理效率，为 AI 辅助材料研究提供统一语言与视觉接口。

title: Tether: Verified Stateful Policy Engine for System-Level Monitoring of Agents
title_zh: Tether：面向Agent系统级监控的可验证有状态策略引擎
abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed for long-running tasks that execute arbitrary shell commands or programs. However, these actions can result in unauthorized network requests or persistent, malicious changes to the user's file system, processes, or privileges. Existing defense mechanisms rely on either LLM-based monitors, which lack provable safety guarantees, or stateless policy enforcement layers, which miss multi-step data flows and execution side-effects unmodeled by the policy language (e.g., network calls initiated inside a Python script). We introduce Tether, a framework for runtime enforcement of stateful security policies over the observed side-effects of an agent's actions. Tether executes each proposed action in an ephemeral, isolated sandbox, inferring abstract action semantics from observed system calls. Tether then enforces stateful policies over these inferred semantics, permitting actions to proceed only if they comply with the policy. Policies and action semantics are defined in an embedded DSL in Lean 4 capable of expressing diverse constraints, including information flow control (IFC), access control, and network security policies. Because actions can propagate labels from sources to destinations, a single rule can enforce fine-grained IFC policies across multi-step execution flows of arbitrary length. Expressing policies in Lean enables formal verification that they satisfy global security invariants (e.g., preventing network access after reading a sensitive file). We evaluate Tether on realistic coding-agent benchmarks across both benign and adversarial trajectories. With a single policy shared across all tasks, Tether blocks 100% of in-scope attacks while maintaining a benign false-positive rate under 5%.
summary_zh: 自主Agent执行长任务时易产生未授权网络请求或恶意系统变更，现有防御缺乏可证安全保证或无法捕捉多步数据流。
提出Tether框架，在隔离沙箱中执行动作并推断系统调用语义，利用Lean 4 DSL强制执行有状态安全策略。
实验表明单一策略可阻断100%范围内攻击，且良性误报率低于5%，同时通过Lean实现策略满足全局安全不变量的形式化验证。

title: Decision-Focused Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-Training
title_zh: 面向LLM后训练的决策聚焦强化学习
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as predictors across various tasks, benefiting from their ability to use information from unstructured context. However, when predictions serve as parameters of downstream optimization problems, higher prediction accuracy does not necessarily translate into lower decision costs. We propose decision-focused reinforcement learning (DFRL), a framework for post-training LLMs to predict optimization parameters using negative downstream decision regret as reward. DFRL trains LLM predictors to minimize the costs of the decisions induced by their predictions, without requiring downstream convexity or differentiability, and integrates readily into existing RL post-training frameworks. To address expensive reward evaluation, we develop two approaches. Heuristic warm-starting uses inexpensive approximate rewards during an initial phase before switching to refinement with exact rewards. Reward correction combines inexpensive estimates with randomized exact evaluations, preserving the expected policy gradient while reducing the expected number of exact solves per update. Experiments on three synthetic optimization problems demonstrate improvements over prediction-loss baselines, while a larger knapsack experiment shows faster early improvement under short training budgets. On inventory planning with H&M transactions and product descriptions, our best configuration, in which the LLM reasons before predicting, reduces regret by 31.4% relative to the SFT baseline and 12.4% relative to the strongest evaluated conventional forecasting baseline.
summary_zh: LLM预测结果作为下游优化问题参数时，更高预测准确率未必降低决策成本。
提出DFRL框架，利用下游决策遗憾作为奖励对LLM进行强化学习后训练，无需下游凸性或可微性。
开发启发式热启动与奖励校正方法降低奖励评估开销，在多个实验中显著降低决策遗憾。

title: Characterizing Age-Conditioned Affective Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉语言模型中年龄条件化情感推理的评估
abstract: An age prompt can change how a vision-language model (VLM) rates the emotion evoked by an image. Does the change predict how people of different ages rate that same image? We evaluate 17 VLMs on 900 OASIS images using young-, middle-, and older-adult prompts and estimate image-specific age differences from ratings by 822 participants. Without an age cue, models closely track average human valence (median Pearson $r=0.891$). Under an older-adult prompt, 16 of 17 models assign lower valence on average than under a young-adult prompt. Yet after adjusting for image pleasantness, correlations between model and human age effects range from $-0.030$ to $0.093$, against an estimated ceiling of $0.595$. The discrepancy is clearest on 54 sensitive images rated as pleasant. Across models, the older prompt reduces valence by $0.845$ points on average, while older participants rate these images $0.443$ points higher than younger participants. Providing human ratings from other images improves agreement on the direction of age differences, although image-specific fidelity remains modest on 600 held-out images ($r_{\mathrm{part}}=0.105$). These results show why evaluations of demographic personalization in foundation models need human comparisons at the level of individual stimuli. Project page available at https://shahriyar-zaman.github.io/age-conditioned-emotion-reasoning/
summary_zh: 现有VLM对年龄提示的情感反应是否与真实人类一致尚不明确，研究通过17个VLM和822名参与者对900张图像的评分进行对比分析。
研究发现，在老年人提示下多数VLM会降低效价评分，但与人类实际年龄差异的相关性极低，甚至在敏感图像上呈现相反趋势。
结论表明，基础模型的人口统计个性化评估必须在个体刺激层面进行人类比较，仅提供其他图像的人类评分难以显著提升一致性。

title: Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking: Memory-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Embodied Navigation
title_zh: 认知视界动作分块：面向具身导航的记忆引导自适应推理
abstract: Multimodal foundation models are advancing embodied navigation, but frequent inference incurs substantial computational cost. We present Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking (CHAC), a training-free framework for memory-guided adaptive reasoning with a frozen navigation policy. Retained visual context, completion cues, and controller feedback determine the cognitive horizon, or how many cached waypoints the robot executes before refreshing its prediction. At the policy's stop request, local visitation history guides a bounded correction with at most one extra movement and no additional model calls. CHAC reduces vision-language model calls by 33.4% on HM3D-OVON and 64.7% on R2R-CE, with success-rate decreases of 0.63 and 10.82 percentage points, respectively. Success rate and success weighted by path length improve per model call on both benchmarks. Across four physical navigation tasks with 40 runs per method, CHAC achieves 18 successes versus 14 for native execution, reducing model calls by 54.9% and GPU inference time by 49.7%.
summary_zh: 多模态基础模型在具身导航中频繁推理导致计算成本过高，需在保持性能的同时降低开销。
提出无需训练的CHAC框架，利用记忆与反馈动态调整执行步数，并在停止时进行局部历史引导的有限修正。
在仿真与物理任务中大幅减少模型调用与GPU推理时间，且单次调用的成功率及路径加权成功率均获提升。

title: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
title_zh: DriftGuard：基于因果归因的 LLM Agent 在线记忆漂移检测
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on persistent memory to plan tool calls and complete multi-step tasks, which exposes them to memory drift: an adversarial or misleading memory alters the execution path and final outcome. In this work, we investigate online memory-drift detection, which estimates each retrieved memory's causal contribution to potential drift at serving time. We identify two fundamental challenges. (1) Content-level features are insufficient for causal memory-drift attribution, as perplexity or retrieval relevance alone cannot determine which retrieved memory would change agent behavior if neutralized; (2) Counterfactual attribution is prohibitively expensive for online detection, as it requires replaying downstream agent and tool execution for each candidate memory, exceeding real-time serving budgets. To address these challenges, we propose DriftGuard, a two-stage framework that decouples offline causal supervision from online estimation. Specifically, DriftGuard first constructs causal supervision through repeated paired counterfactual replays, continuing the original and single-memory neutralized trajectory suffixes from a shared pre-action state. The resulting annotations are aggregated by component-wise majority voting into a memory drift score (MDS) that captures action change, attack removal, violation removal, and task recovery. Guided by this supervision, DriftGuard then learns an online risk model that estimates MDS from pre-action information and flags drift-inducing memories via its maximum component risk, without online counterfactual rollouts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DriftGuard accurately identifies drift-inducing memories and enables efficient online defense. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DriftGuard-7F0B.
summary_zh: LLM agent 依赖持久记忆执行多步任务，但易受对抗或误导记忆影响产生记忆漂移，改变执行路径与结果。
现有方法因内容特征不足且反事实归因成本过高，难以满足在线检测需求；DriftGuard 提出两阶段框架解耦离线因果监督与在线估计。
该方法通过离线反事实重放构建记忆漂移分数并训练在线风险模型，无需在线重放即可高效准确地识别并防御漂移记忆。

title: AutoRAGBench: A Benchmark for LLM Agents Automating RAG System Development
title_zh: AutoRAGBench：评估LLM agent自动化开发RAG系统的基准
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a well-established paradigm for augmenting large language models (LLMs) with information retrieved from external corpora. However, developing effective RAG systems requires substantial engineering effort and iterative experimentation, as effective design choices vary across tasks and domains. With rapid advances in LLM agent capabilities, we ask how well these agents can autonomously build RAG systems and how effectively they can improve them through iteration. In this paper, we propose AutoRAGBench, the first benchmark to evaluate how well LLM agents develop RAG systems from scratch in an open code space. It comprises nine RAG system development tasks. For each task, agents build RAG systems from scratch without starter code or prescribed strategies, under a six-hour budget on a single H800 GPU. They analyze task data, implement RAG pipelines, and iteratively refine their designs based on experimental feedback. We evaluate nine agent configurations and analyze both the effectiveness of the resulting RAG systems and their development trajectories. GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI achieves the highest average score of 56.1. The composite Human-SOTA baseline averages 44.4. These results show that LLM agents can automate effective RAG system development. When starting from a human-designed system on each of seven tasks, GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex CLI improves the score by 16.6 points on average.
summary_zh: 构建有效RAG系统需大量工程与迭代实验，且最优设计因任务和领域而异。
提出AutoRAGBench基准，让LLM agent在无初始代码和固定策略下从零构建并迭代优化RAG系统。
实验表明LLM agent能有效自动化RAG开发，最优配置超越人类基线，并在已有系统上进一步提升性能。

title: Diagnosis is not a policy: a state-transition audit of caoability-conditioned test-time inference
title_zh: 诊断非策略：能力条件测试时推理的状态转移审计
abstract: Test-time actions can satisfy retrieval, state-realization, program-consistency, or rendering objectives without correcting an answer. Test-time Error Response and Realizability Audit (TERRA) is an evaluation/auditing protocol, not a new inference algorithm. It uses a unified decomposition of intervention outcomes into applicability, target-state realization, endpoint translation, harm, and resource/inference cost. Paired comparisons fix the incoming state and evaluation conditions; cross-model analyses vary the receiving configuration. Executable financial reasoning experiments yield three findings: the same context expansion can harm one configuration and benefit another; sufficient evidence does not ensure correctness because configurations differ in evidence-to-answer translation; and diagnostic headroom---accuracy attainable with idealized diagnostic information over the measured baseline---plus local consistency does not ensure practical gains.
