Action value is $V(a\mid x,m)$, not diagnosis alone; diagnosis is not a deployable policy $π(a\mid x,m)$.
summary_zh: 测试时动作可能满足检索或渲染等目标但未纠正答案，需评估其真实干预效果。
提出TERRA审计协议，将干预结果分解为适用性、状态实现、端点转换、危害与成本等维度。
金融推理实验表明，充足证据不保证正确性，诊断信息带来的准确率提升空间不等于实际收益。

title: Is a Description Worth a Thousand Demonstrations? Specificity and Reliability of Task Descriptions in In-Context Learning
title_zh: 任务描述在上下文学习中的特异性与可靠性分析
abstract: A prompt for in-context learning (ICL) can describe a task in addition to, or instead of, demonstrating it through examples. Yet how task descriptions work remains poorly understood theoretically. Through the Bayesian view of ICL, we model descriptions as informative priors characterized by their specificity and reliability. We adapt the effective sample size (ESS) from Bayesian statistics, quantifying a description's predictive value as an equivalent number of demonstrations. For in-context linear regression, we show that a reliable description's ESS grows with its specificity and with the task's dimension. A description that may be irrelevant, however, gains little from its specificity unless demonstrations are given. In practice, do in-context learners use descriptions as a Bayes-optimal predictor would? Our experiments show that meta-trained Transformers come close to the Bayes-optimal ESS when tested on their training distribution. Pretrained language models, however, make too little use of highly specific descriptions when answering without reasoning; most of them closely match the Bayes-optimal predictor only when reasoning is enabled. These results extend the Bayesian analysis of ICL from demonstrations to descriptions.
summary_zh: 现有上下文学习对任务描述的理论机制理解不足，需探究其如何影响模型预测。
基于贝叶斯视角将描述建模为先验，用有效样本量量化描述的预测价值。
可靠描述的等效样本量随特异性增加，且预训练语言模型需借助推理才能接近贝叶斯最优。

title: Towards Autoregressive Neural Network Parameter Generation
title_zh: 探索自回归神经网络参数生成方法
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently established a new paradigm in machine learning, demonstrating exceptional zero-shot generalization and complex reasoning capabilities. Concurrently, neural network parameter generation has emerged as a promising avenue for rapid task adaptation and model synthesis. Existing weight generation techniques, however, struggle to jointly learn the distribution of diverse models, to encode heterogeneous architectures within a single generator, and to generalize out of distribution. We therefore ask whether pretrained parameters can be encoded into a discrete domain so that the zero-shot generalization LLMs exhibit in text generation can be transferred to weight generation. Following this view, we propose an LLM-inspired approach, Instruction-Guided Parameter Generation (IGPG), that formulates network parameter generation as an autoregressive modeling problem. We first quantize pretrained weights with a VQ-VAE, then train a prefix-conditioned autoregressive generator over the resulting tokens. At inference, the generated weight tokens are mapped back to parameter space by the VQ-VAE decoder. We evaluate the framework across in-distribution generation, cross-dataset transfer, and cross-architecture settings. The proposed method achieves competitive performance in in-distribution generation and provides useful parameter initializations for held-out datasets and architectural configurations, improving downstream performance over random initialization after adaptation. These results suggest that discrete autoregressive modeling provides a promising framework for learning and transferring structure across collections of pretrained neural network parameters.
summary_zh: 现有权重生成方法难以统一学习多样模型分布、编码异构架构并实现分布外泛化。
提出IGPG方法，利用VQ-VAE量化预训练权重，并训练前缀条件自回归生成器生成权重token。
该方法在分布内生成具竞争力，且为未见数据集和架构提供有效参数初始化，提升下游性能。

title: LM-based Personalized Travel Planner
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的个性化多智能体旅行规划框架
abstract: Effective travel planning requires handling multiple information sources, managing constraints, and tailoring recommendations to user preferences. While LLMs have introduced dynamic, context-aware decision-making, single-agent models often struggle with complex multi-step reasoning, constraint adherence, and modular execution. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent framework where a supervising chatbot agent coordinates specialized agents for schedule validation, user query formulation, real-time data retrieval, and constraint-aware itinerary generation. By integrating LLM reasoning, external APIs, and iterative refinement mechanisms based on a deterministic, multi-dimensional scoring framework, our approach ensures adaptability, efficiency, and personalization. Evaluations on the well-known TravelPlanner benchmark demonstrate improvements in Budget Constraint planning by 10\%, wider constraints set-based planning by 25\%, and personalized planning results by 45\%. compared to the ReAct baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/nimashaklaa/TravelPlanner_Research
summary_zh: 单agent模型在复杂多步推理、约束遵守和模块化执行上存在困难，难以满足个性化旅行规划需求。
提出分层多agent框架，由监督agent协调调度、数据检索和约束感知等专门agent，并结合外部API与迭代优化机制。
在TravelPlanner基准上，相比ReAct基线，预算约束规划提升10%，个性化规划提升45%。

title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
title_zh: LingSante MedGuard：医疗AI统一安全护栏技术报告
abstract: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and applying medical requirements under their intended conditions. We introduce LingSante MedGuard, a capability-enhanced guardrail that integrates supervision from a medical guardrail teacher model and six specialized medical capability experts into a unified model. The guardrail teacher supervises risk decisions and explanations across medical safety, compliance, and ethics, while the capability experts support medical rule understanding, numerical reasoning, multimodal hallucination detection, agentic safety verification, risk localization, and multimodal entity understanding. We consolidate these sources of supervision through offline supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated demonstrations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using feedback on student-generated responses. We further introduce LingSante MedGuardBench, a benchmark comprising 11 risk-detection subsets spanning medical safety, compliance, and ethics. At 4B, 9B, and 27B scales, LingSante MedGuard achieves mean benchmark F1 scores of 82.3%, 82.4%, and 87.4%, respectively. The 4B model also achieves 73.9% mean accuracy across MedHallu and MedHALT-NOTA under retrieval-enabled evaluation. Additional evaluations of the verification components show improvements in evidence-supported consistency, source traceability, and rule-guided rationale quality across model scales. These results support the integration of specialized medical capabilities into a unified guardrail for medical risk assessment and evidence-based medical safety verification.
summary_zh: 医疗AI应用日益广泛，亟需识别不合规或有伦理风险的响应以保障安全部署。
提出LingSante MedGuard护栏，融合教师模型与六大医疗能力专家，通过微调与多教师蒸馏统一监督。
构建MedGuardBench基准，模型在多尺度下取得高F1分数，验证了统一护栏在医疗风险检测上的有效性。

title: Why Do LLMs Help with Scientific Misconduct Requests and What to Do About It?: Increasing the Trustworthiness of AI for Science
title_zh: 为何LLM会协助学术不端请求及应对策略
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) support scientific research, but some of that assistance can also undermine research integrity. Existing safety evaluations in science often measure whether models refuse misconduct requests, but rarely explain whether they even recognize the problem or why they comply. We investigate this gap across 8 LLMs using SciIntBench, an existing benchmark of 1,350 prompts about scientific research integrity. We examine the reasons behind compliance in four steps. First, when asked directly whether fulfilling a request would involve misconduct, models overwhelmingly identify such requests, even in the Most Covert cases (91%), while they refuse to carry out the request in only 34% of cases. Second, we examine which request characteristics are associated with refusal using features that capture how the request is framed, how much the assistant has been told about what it is helping to hide, and how the goal and the user's stake are stated, among others. Third, we estimate that the most significant effect was to rephrase requests as questions about permissibility rather than instructions, which increased refusal from 52% to 88%. Finally, we test two system-prompt fixes: asking models to assess the request before responding and reminding them of responsible conduct of research principles. These changes increase refusal rates on adversarial requests from 58% to 87% and 86%, respectively. Our findings show that models recognize wrongful requests but still help users violate integrity. Understanding why these failures occur and testing ways to reduce them offer promising paths toward more trustworthy AI for science.
summary_zh: 现有安全评估很少解释LLM为何顺从学术不端请求，研究基于SciIntBench基准探究8个模型顺从行为的原因。
模型虽能识别不端请求但顺从率仍高，将指令改写为许可性问题或调整系统提示可显著提升拒绝率。
研究揭示了模型识别与行为不一致的缺陷，为提升科学AI的可信度提供了有效干预路径。

title: Distributed Regenerative Resource Allocation with Exact Centralized Optimality
title_zh: 具有精确集中式最优性的分布式再生资源分配
abstract: This letter presents a Distributed Regenerative Resource Allocation (or DRRA) framework for multi-agent networks with utility-driven resource regeneration, in which the resource available for the next allocation round depends endogenously on the utility generated by the agents in the previous allocation. We develop fully distributed, two-stage inner--outer dynamics that perform primal--dual allocation and resource regeneration. Under sufficient distributed algorithmic gain conditions, the inner dynamics exhibit local exponential convergence to a Lyapunov-stable equilibrium. After inner convergence, the DRRA allocation exactly recovers the centralized optimum, and the local resource-reference updates exactly reproduce the centralized resource-regeneration dynamics.
summary_zh: 针对多智能体网络中效用驱动的资源再生问题，提出分布式再生资源分配（DRRA）框架。
设计全分布式两阶段内外层动力学，执行原始-对偶分配与资源再生更新过程。
在满足分布式增益条件下，该机制局部指数收敛，且能精确恢复集中式最优分配与再生动态。

title: Side-Channel Analysis of the RP2350 Challenge 2
title_zh: RP2350挑战2的侧信道分析
abstract: Bug bounty programs and community challenges have become an established mechanism to incentivize collective action to improve security. In essence, these can be considered as crowd-sourcing mechanisms where participants carry the risk twice over: performing the work in addition to having it officially accepted, which at times can be tied to unacceptable terms. Consequently, independent assessments and publications that are free from third party obligations remain important to highlight deficiencies in implementations of public significance. We consider the RP2350 side-channel analysis challenge and its hardened Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) implementation to be of reasonable importance to justify such an approach, especially so since the presented challenge remained unsolved for more than a year. In our paper, we present our analysis, demonstrating comprehensive leakage detection, plaintext dependence, and key extraction from the challenge implementation. Our work presents concerning weaknesses in the implementation that contradict the challenge authors' claims. We hope by openly sharing this analysis to motivate further public scrutiny.
summary_zh: 针对RP2350侧信道挑战中加固的AES实现长期未被攻破的问题，开展独立的侧信道分析。
通过全面的泄漏检测与明文依赖性分析，成功从挑战实现中提取了密钥。
发现该实现存在与挑战作者声明相悖的严重弱点，呼吁开展更多公开安全审查。

title: ToolPulse: Side-Channel Eavesdropping on Tool-Using LLM Agents
title_zh: ToolPulse：针对工具调用LLM Agent的侧信道窃听攻击
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that translate user requests into sequences of local tool invocations. While prior cache-based side-channel attacks target the locally deployed models, they typically require the adversary to share model-related components or hardware resources with the victim's inference process. These assumptions do not apply to the predominant agentic settings, in which commercial LLMs execute on vendor-controlled infrastructure. We show that agentic execution exposes a more practical attack surface: although inference remains remote, tools are executed on the user's machine and commonly rely on shared system libraries. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate Flush+Reload and Prime+Probe for monitoring agentic tool invocations. Our evaluation across three hardware platforms shows that Flush+Reload enables accurate, real-time tool monitoring, whereas Prime+Probe, despite supporting cross-VM attacks, incurs prohibitive monitoring overhead and suffers from cache-set aliasing. We present ToolPulse, a cache-based side-channel eavesdropping framework against tool-using agents. We first design the Tool Recovery Attack to reconstruct an agent's tool-execution workflow. We evaluate the Tool Recovery Attack on 11 LLMs across Codex and Claude Code. It consistently reconstructs tool workflows, with the lowest F1 score exceeding 93%. We further demonstrate two attack scenarios enabled by the recovered traces. Task Profiling Attack infers user intent across two Terminal-Bench task categories and the Trigger Localization Attack identifies sensitive tool calls in encryption/decryption and model training/inference workloads. Even under substantial system noise on a server shared by approximately 20 users, both Task Profiling Attack and Trigger Localization Attack maintain high accuracy.
summary_zh: 现有侧信道攻击依赖共享模型组件，不适用于运行在厂商基础设施上的商业LLM Agent，存在安全盲区。
利用工具在用户本地执行且依赖共享系统库的特点，提出基于缓存的侧信道窃听框架ToolPulse。
实验表明该攻击能高准确率重建工具执行流程，并推断用户意图与定位敏感调用，揭示Agent实际安全风险。

title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
title_zh: ActMem：从潜在记忆推理到具身机器人动作
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role. However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem and https://huggingface.co/donk111/ActMem.
summary_zh: 现有记忆增强 VLA 在长时程操作中存在检索缺乏推理或历史挤占当前感知的问题。
提出 ActMem 框架，在单一 VLM 中解耦记忆推理与感知，利用潜在记忆 CoT 引导动作专家。
引入高效推理重用计算，在仿真与真实任务中均显著超越基线，验证了方法的有效性。
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem

title: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning
title_zh: PAIR-MED：面向多语言医疗推理的迭代优化框架
abstract: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.
summary_zh: LLM在多语言医疗推理上表现不均，且固定PRM在强化学习中易与策略分布失配，降低监督可靠性。
提出策略与奖励交替训练框架，利用策略生成轨迹更新PRM，再由PRM提供过程级奖励指导下一轮策略优化。
构建8B和9B规模模型，在多语言医疗基准上显著提升准确率、语言一致性与逻辑准确性，验证了方法有效性。

title: RoCoKV: Accelerating LLM Inference Serving through Uncertainty and Redundancy Aware KV Cache Compression
title_zh: RoCoKV：基于不确定性与冗余感知的KV缓存压缩加速LLM推理
abstract: KV cache compression is critical for large reasoning models, where most of the cost comes from long generated reasoning traces rather than the input prompt. These traces often contain redundant and low-utility tokens due to looping, self-verification, and corrections. However, such tokens may still receive high attention scores, making it difficult to remove them without harming the reasoning process. We propose RoCoKV, a KV cache compression method designed for large reasoning models. RoCoKV introduces two key components. First, uncertainty-guided adaptive pruning adjusts the compression strength based on the model's confidence, allocating more memory during uncertain phases and applying stronger pruning when the model is confident. Second, redundancy-aware token selection reduces the impact of tokens that are highly similar to recent reasoning content, encouraging the model to retain more informative and diverse tokens. Beyond the algorithm, we co-design RoCoKV with the serving stack: we develop fused three-phase CUDA decode kernels and integrate them into vLLM as a drop-in plugin that preserves its paged KV layout and CUDA graph capture, turning algorithmic savings into real end-to-end speedups. Extensive experiments across three reasoning benchmarks and two reasoning models demonstrate that RoCoKV consistently improves reasoning accuracy under constrained KV cache budgets, achieving higher accuracy compared to state-of-the-art KV cache compression methods. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B in vLLM, RoCoKV achieves a 1.27X speedup and 38% higher throughput on AIME25, the most challenging evaluated reasoning benchmark, and a 1.43X speedup and 45% higher throughput on the long synthetic benchmark, compared with Full-KV.
summary_zh: 大型推理模型的长推理轨迹存在大量冗余且低效用的token，但常获高注意力分数，难以在不损害推理的前提下安全压缩。
提出RoCoKV方法，结合不确定性引导的自适应剪枝与冗余感知的token选择，在模型不确定时保留更多记忆，确信时强剪枝并保留高信息量token。
将算法与vLLM推理栈协同设计，在受限缓存预算下显著提升推理准确率，并在AIME25等基准上实现1.27倍以上端到端加速与大幅吞吐提升。

title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
title_zh: 基于不确定性条件的生物医学知识图谱表型假设推理
abstract: Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks upstream uncertainty, with Spearman correlations of 0.951 and 0.878, respectively; ablations identify the contribution of uncertainty conditioning. In masked-edge recovery, the model exceeds chance and degree-matched probability-permutation controls. Training the energy under the uncertainty-dependent temperature yields higher held-out recall@10 than training under a constant temperature of comparable magnitude. Under gene hold-out, recall@10 exceeds that of a trained DistMult embedding on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123); this difference is attributable mainly to three genes with many variants and is not established for all genes. These results establish an uncertainty-aware interface from genomic predictions to graph-supported phenotype hypotheses that combines interpretable probability allocation with held-out association recovery of explicitly stated scope.
summary_zh: 基因组基础模型提供变异证据，但连接至表型假设需处理结构化推理中的不确定性。
提出不确定性条件路径能量框架，将序列预测与校准不确定性转化为表型假设分布，无需患者级监督。
实验表明表型熵与上游不确定性高度相关，且在基因保留评估中召回率优于DistMult基线。

title: DiLE: Discrimination-Aware Latent-Space Learning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
title_zh: DiLE：面向通用多模态嵌入的判别感知潜在空间学习
abstract: Multimodal large language models have greatly improved input understanding in universal multimodal embedding models. However, this understanding does not ensure that their embeddings preserve the evidence needed to distinguish relevant items from confusable alternatives. To preserve essential discriminative evidence in embeddings, this paper proposes DiLE, a discrimination-aware latent-space learning framework that combines task guidance with on-policy retrieval feedback. Specifically, a few learnable queries are used to encode task-relevant information in a compact latent space. Reasoning instructions and auxiliary answer-generation supervision shape these representations to support both task understanding and retrieval discrimination. To address task-specific discriminative needs, we design shared-private expert adaptation that integrates cross-task knowledge sharing with task-specific representation learning. Building on this, the on-policy hard-negative distillation is introduced: the student retrieves confusable candidates, and a reverse KL divergence objective aligns its embedding-based similarity distribution with the teacher's fine-grained relevance distribution over these candidates. Candidates are periodically refreshed using updated student snapshots, tying teacher supervision to the student's evolving retrieval behavior and confusions. Across four model configurations that span two backbone generations, DiLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMEB-v2, UVRB, and MRMR, demonstrating its effectiveness across modalities and tasks.
summary_zh: 多模态大模型虽提升了输入理解，但嵌入难以保留区分易混淆样本的判别证据。
提出DiLE框架，结合任务引导与策略内检索反馈，通过共享私有专家适应与硬负样本蒸馏优化表征。
在MMEB-v2、UVRB和MRMR基准上达到SOTA，验证了跨模态与跨任务的有效性。

title: Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning for Mammography Vision--Language Models
title_zh: 面向乳腺X光VLM的双侧证据选择与推理方法
abstract: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) often need to identify small, subtle lesions within high-resolution images containing extensive normal anatomy and redundant visual information. Visual-token compression improves efficiency, but preserving salient regions alone can discard the context needed for diagnostic interpretation. This context can extend across images: in bilateral mammography, the opposite breast provides a patient-specific anatomical reference. Yet retaining such evidence does not ensure that the model uses it effectively. We propose Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning (BESR), which connects evidence preservation with comparative assessment through a bilateral-guided token selector and a bilateral reward. Under a shared token budget, the selector jointly prioritizes lesion appearance and its local and bilateral context, while the reward encourages assessments that benefit from the preserved comparison. Experiments on a bilateral dataset constructed from CBIS-DDSM and on VinDr-Mammo demonstrate improved evidence retention and diagnostic performance under constrained visual-token budgets. Inference benchmarking further shows reduced prefill latency.
summary_zh: 医学VLM处理高分辨率图像时，视觉token压缩易丢失诊断所需的双侧解剖上下文。
提出BESR方法，通过双侧引导token选择器和双侧奖励机制，联合保留病灶及其局部与双侧上下文。
实验表明该方法在受限token预算下提升了诊断性能，并降低了推理延迟。

title: ChainAgent: Automated Chainable Vulnerability Discovery in PHP Web Applications
title_zh: ChainAgent：PHP Web应用漏洞链自动化发现框架
abstract: High-impact attacks on PHP web applications often chain limited-capability vulnerabilities with other flaws or intended behaviors. Discovering these chains requires identifying flaws and the dependencies enabling capability composition. Existing vulnerability discovery techniques analyze flaws in isolation, while attack planning assumes known components. This separation makes it difficult to discover previously unknown components whose security relevance becomes apparent only through their potential roles in an exploit chain. We present ChainAgent, a goal-directed LLM-agent framework that jointly discovers exploit-chain components and their capability dependencies in source code. Guided by an empirical study of 386 real-world web exploit chains, ChainAgent represents vulnerabilities and functional gadgets--intended program behaviors that can be repurposed in attacks--through preconditions and capabilities over security-relevant objects. Instead of discovering vulnerabilities first and constructing attack paths afterward, ChainAgent uses an evolving exploit graph to guide source-code inspection. It searches backward from unmet preconditions for capability producers and forward from discovered capabilities for functional gadgets that consume or amplify them. Object-centered chaining knowledge from our empirical study directs searches toward promising vulnerability classes, functional operations, and object accesses. We evaluate ChainAgent against Codex, a general-purpose coding agent, on 15 PHP applications across three shared LLM backends. ChainAgent achieves 42.02%--44.63% recall for goal-reaching components and recovers up to 4.4 times as many correct goal-reaching dependency edges as Codex. An additional evaluation of 30 real-world PHP applications identifies 20 vulnerabilities and 13 exploit chains, nine of which achieve remote code execution (RCE).
summary_zh: 现有漏洞发现技术孤立分析缺陷，难以挖掘仅在利用链中才显现安全相关性的未知组件。
提出基于LLM-agent的ChainAgent框架，利用不断演进的利用图指导源码检查，双向搜索能力依赖。
在15个PHP应用评估中，其召回率达42.02%至44.63%，正确依赖边数量最高达Codex的4.4倍。

title: AI-Native Industrial Control Systems: An Agent Architecture for the Control System Lifecycle
title_zh: AI原生工业控制系统：面向生命周期的Agent架构
abstract: Industrial control systems increasingly use AI for perception, control, and engineering, while available control functions and execution environments are typically established in advance. This paper proposes an AI-native industrial control system in which collaborating agents determine the capabilities required by a task, construct the control application, and prepare its execution environment. System-level agents coordinate device-level agents within configured resource and permission constraints. A physical sorting workstation illustrates two forms of adaptation. In the first case, controller and robot agents construct a sorting application on a prescribed Raspberry Pi target. In the second, a camera agent adds inspection on an edge node, and the controller associates inspection results with downstream pickup decisions. A subsequent revision enables selective sorting using the same agents and deployment arrangement. The trials demonstrate the feasibility of task-driven construction and evolution on the workstation. Commissioning also reveals limitations in the traceability of design decisions, adherence to delegated responsibilities, diagnostic reasoning, and verification of physical behavior.
summary_zh: 现有工业控制系统AI功能与环境多预设，难以动态适配任务需求
提出由系统级与设备级协作的Agent架构，按需构建控制应用与执行环境
分拣工作站试验验证了任务驱动构建的可行性，并暴露了可追溯性及诊断验证等局限

title: Toward a Science of AI Agent Societies
title_zh: 迈向AI agent社会的研究科学
abstract: AI agents are rapidly evolving from isolated personal assistants into networked actors that interact with one another at scale. We envision the emergence of AI agent societies, with their own social and economic dynamics, as a new research frontier. We argue that AI agent societies should be studied as a distinct object of inquiry: neither simply larger collections of individual agents nor merely simulations of human society. To formalize this perspective, we propose four core properties that a valid AI agent society should satisfy: individualized objectives, rules and governance, autonomy, and scale and complexity. Building on this framework, we identify four classes of societal behaviors worth studying in AI agent societies: economic behaviors, behaviors under conflict-of-interest, unsafe and unethical behaviors, and system-level behaviors. We then outline key technical challenges--including property parameterization, parameter balancing, and robust implementation--and argue that progress on these challenges could enable scientifically informative and practically useful models of AI agent societies. Finally, we revisit existing multi-agent systems through the lens of the proposed core properties, show that they instantiate only subsets of them, and discuss implications for platform design, evaluation, and governance.
summary_zh: AI agent正从孤立助手转变为大规模互动的网络化主体，亟需将其社会作为独立研究对象。
提出AI agent社会需满足个性化目标、规则治理、自主性及规模复杂性四项核心属性。
归纳四类社会行为与技术挑战，指出现有系统仅具备部分属性，为平台设计与治理提供启示。

title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: 时间序列预测中可证伪的复合推理
abstract: Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions. Real-world time series are generated by recurring latent primitives that co-move within finite historical windows. Under strong historical co-movement, chronological holdout error cannot separate predictors that learn invariant couplings among primitives from predictors that fit transient historical correlations. Searching over large pools of architectures, hyperparameters, or chain-of-thought rules further biases selection toward historical shortcuts. Through theoretical analysis and diagnostic experiments on a controlled multi-primitive benchmark and German day-ahead electricity prices, we show that expanding validation search fails to improve out-of-regime accuracy, and that decomposing primitives without an ex-ante falsification test still breaks down when residual correlations shift. Hence, we propose formulating time series forecasting and reasoning around falsifiable compositional hypotheses that combine neural primitive encoders, explicit coupling constraints, and training-calibrated falsification tests.
summary_zh: 现有模型在历史验证集表现优异，但在非平稳状态转换时性能下降，原因是将回测作为开放式搜索目标而非检验预设假设。
理论分析与实验表明，扩大验证搜索无法提升跨状态预测精度，缺乏证伪检验的基元分解在残差相关性变化时仍会失效。
提出围绕可证伪复合假设构建预测与推理框架，结合神经基元编码器、显式耦合约束与训练校准的证伪测试。

title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
title_zh: TuringSpace：基于交互式验证码的空间智能评测与训练环境
abstract: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.
summary_zh: 现有空间基准缺乏对动作交互的要求，难以评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉世界中行动并自我纠正的能力。
提出合成网络环境 TuringSpace，包含125个需通过点击和拖拽解决的交互式验证码，覆盖五种空间能力并可作为可扩展的训练场。
实验发现顶尖模型仍存在较高失败率且常产生幻觉辩护错误，而在此环境微调模型不仅大幅提升成功率，还能泛化至真实世界基准。
研究揭示了 MLLM 在屏幕动作空间智能上的不足，并提供了一种可扩展且能迁移至真实场景的训练方法。

title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
title_zh: 超越权重更新：面向领域专精的 Agent Harness 进化方法
abstract: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer. The resulting harness adapters require no GPU training, are loadable per vertical domain, and compose with weight-based RL. Experiments with Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench show a consistent pattern: weight updates give the strongest single-path gains, harness evolution recovers most of those gains at a small fraction of the compute, and combining both paths is best overall. We also analyze a failure mode of SFT-based specialization---shortened reasoning chains and increased truncation---and argue that harness adapters avoid it by construction. Our results position harness evolution as a practical, non-destructive complement to weight updates for vertical agents.
summary_zh: LLM 领域专精常依赖 SFT 或 RL 更新权重，但存在推理链缩短等问题。
提出将系统提示与工具库等 harness 的进化作为 RL 外环，用 GEPA 优化器进行无 GPU 训练的适配。
实验表明该方法能以极低算力恢复大部分权重更新收益，且两者结合效果最佳。

title: Fold the Loop: Decoding-Time KV Memory for Looped Vision-Language Models
title_zh: FoldCache：面向循环视觉语言模型的解码期KV内存压缩方法
abstract: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen visual reasoning by repeatedly applying weight-tied modules. However, their decoding memory grows with recurrent depth and limits the image size and batch size that fit in a fixed memory budget. Each recurrent step produces its own key-value (KV) states, so the cache holds several copies of the same image. We find that, after an exact prefill, earlier steps still need access to visual information but can reuse the final visual KV within the same module. We propose FoldCache, which compresses visual KV along the recurrent axis while preserving the full prefill computation. FoldCache partitions recurrent steps within each module into groups and retains the final visual KV of each group for its members to share during decoding. Sharing stays within module boundaries, while question and answer KV remain separate for each step. The grouping granularity controls the degree of compression, and folding can be combined with token eviction and quantization to further reduce memory use. On LoopVL, FoldCache approximately halves prefix KV memory while matching full-cache accuracy on five open-ended benchmarks. These memory savings support batch sizes up to 1.7 times those of a full cache under the same GPU memory budget, and up to 2.6 times with the more aggressive FoldCache-Lite.
summary_zh: 循环VLM在深化视觉推理时，因循环深度增加导致解码KV缓存成倍增长，限制了图像尺寸与批处理大小。
提出FoldCache，在保留完整预填充计算的前提下，按模块对循环步骤分组并共享组内最终视觉KV，实现沿循环轴的内存压缩。
实验表明该方法在五个基准上保持精度，将前缀KV内存减半，并在同等GPU内存下将批处理大小提升至2.6倍。

title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
title_zh: 打破循环：面向System 1决策Agent的循环触发路由机制
abstract: System 1 decision models (represented by Jev) provide fast, low-cost action selection, but existing agent integrations do not reliably translate these local advantages into task completion. At certain points during execution, an agent may repeatedly select the same actions without making progress toward its goal. LLM-based policies offer strong reasoning capabilities that support planning within an agent, but invoking them at every step incurs substantial overhead. The effective coordination should therefore preserve Jev's fast local action selection while introducing LLM reasoning when execution stalls. We observe that recurring state-action pairs can signal stalled execution. We therefore propose LoopRoute, a simple but effective action router that uses this signal to allocate control within an agent. The decision model acts by default. When a loop is detected, the LLM provides brief, feedback-driven assistance and then returns control to the decision model. Later loops can request further assistance. The rule requires neither additional training nor model-specific confidence calibration. Across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, LoopRoute improves task success over standalone Jev with only limited use of the LLM policy. The mean gains are 21.0%, 60.1%, and 30.1% on ALFWorld, MapReader, and TextWorld cooking, respectively. Compared with full LLM control, LoopRoute also substantially reduces the mean cumulative API time and API-call cost per task. The same rule also improves the success rates of six frozen decision models.
summary_zh: System 1决策模型虽能快速选择动作，但agent执行时常陷入重复状态导致任务停滞，而全程调用LLM又会带来巨大开销。
提出LoopRoute路由机制，通过检测重复状态对触发LLP提供反馈辅助，随后控制权交还决策模型，无需额外训练。
在多个基准测试中，该方法较独立决策模型显著提升任务成功率，并大幅降低LLM的API时间与调用成本。

title: Incorporating argumentation frameworks for LLM decision-making: Task-specific design and evaluation
title_zh: 结合论证框架的LLM决策：任务特定设计与评估
abstract: Argumentation frameworks (AFs) provide explicit, formal mechanisms for representing and resolving conflicts and thus have been incorporated into large language model (LLM) decision-making. The benefits vary and depend on how arguments and their relations are constructed, evaluated, and incorporated into the decision process. {We abstract a workflow consisting of four stages based on existing argumentation-augmented methods} and investigate their design choices over tasks of debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification. Our evaluation with recent LLMs shows that existing methods do not consistently improve performance across the considered tasks. Motivated by this observation, we develop two task-specific methods. The first is called Qnt-Arg, which organizes arguments around the original speakers in debate materials and aggregates model-estimated argument strengths and candidate-answer priors under gradual semantics. The second is Qlt-Arg that uses credibility estimates to establish preferences between conflicting evidence items and applies grounded semantics to select acceptable evidence for subsequent LLM inference. We examine the roles of generative and decision models within the two methods. In the debate setting, Qnt-Arg consistently outperforms other argumentation-augmented methods across matched configurations; Qlt-Arg improves retrieval-based fact-verification performance compared with the baselines. These findings demonstrate the value of combining formal argumentation and LLM while highlighting the importance of aligning with tasks in argumentation construction, model selection, and the role of formal semantic reasoning.
summary_zh: 现有论证框架增强LLM的方法效果不一，未能在辩论决策和检索事实验证任务中稳定提升性能。
针对上述问题，提出Qnt-Arg与Qlt-Arg两种任务特定方法，分别利用渐近语义和基础语义处理证据。
实验表明两种方法均优于基线，证明形式论证与LLM结合的价值，并强调论证构建需与任务对齐。

title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
title_zh: AppSci-Bench：评估LLM构建AI agent的能力
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building them. To this end, we introduce AppSci-Bench, where we construct a setting akin to how human Applied Scientists build agents for businesses - through eliciting task requirements from stakeholders, exploring the business's infrastructure, and scientifically improve the target agent by designing experiments and internal benchmarks. AppSci-Bench features seven realistic domains - five new ones (Slides Generation, Order-to-Cash, Compliance Review, Customer Call Insights, and CRM Insights) and two domains recast from tau3-bench (Yao et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2026b)(Airline and Banking) - each with a held-out evaluation suite customized for that task. We evaluate seven frontier models and find AppSci-Bench challenging: the best model, Claude Opus 5.0, only reaches a mean-minimum score of 59.1% across 3 build attempts; other models do significantly worse. Models struggle with eliciting task requirements (only 65% for Opus 5.0), build representative internal evaluations (models saturate their own evaluation 65% of the time but fail to solve the held-out task), presenting challenges for future research. The benchmark code is available here: https://github.com/sanjari-orb/appsci-bench.
summary_zh: 现有基准多评估LLM驱动的agent，缺乏衡量LLM构建agent能力的基准。
提出AppSci-Bench，模拟应用科学家通过需求获取、基础设施探索和实验设计来改进agent。
评估七个前沿模型发现任务极具挑战，最佳模型仅达59.1%，在需求获取和内部评估构建上存在困难。

title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
title_zh: Pro² Agent：面向自主AI研发的科学问题探查框架
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. It then performs targeted research to relate the identified problems to candidate solutions. Through controlled hypothesis testing, the agent updates the importance of a suspected problem or the benefit brought by a candidate solution. On the complete MLE-Bench, Pro$^2$ Agent matches the best reported medal rate (70.7%) under the standard 24-hour budget and reaches 76.0% with a 48-hour budget, the highest medal rate reported on the complete benchmark. It also achieves competitive performance on PostTrainBench. In addition, it produces research notes for each task that make the research process transparent and reusable by human researchers.
summary_zh: 现有LLM agent做自主研究时仅迭代优化代码，忽略任务背后的问题结构，在复杂任务中易陷入错误解空间。
提出Pro² Agent，将研究主状态从代码库转为显式的Problem State，通过分析资源约束、定向研究与受控假设检验来更新问题与候选解。
在MLE-Bench上达到70.7%奖牌率，48小时预算下达76.0%，并生成透明可复用的研究笔记。

title: From FIPS to FPGA with LLM Agents: Measuring What Tests and Reviews Miss in Post-Quantum Cryptographic Hardware
title_zh: 用 LLM agent 将后量子密码硬件从 FIPS 移植到 FPGA
abstract: As LLM agents increasingly generate RTL alongside the tests and reviews that validate it, self-generated evidence is a weak foundation for trustworthy hardware. We present our seven-stage verification-gated workflow, evolved during a post-quantum design port, in which a gate counts only if shown able to fail on negative controls and fault mutants, and reviewer agents audit work before commit. We then audit this evidence with tool-selected netlist mutants, flaw replays, and formal checks. The flow ported an ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65 accelerator to a 300 MHz Zynq UltraScale+ key-custody card: all six operations are byte-exact on the board, and it passes all 85 interface-applicable NIST ACVP cases (of 285) and 484 ML-DSA known answers. However, passing module tests overstate the verification strength. Across three RTL modules, existing simulation gates kill only 76% of 399 tool-selected netlist mutants; specification-derived tests guided by the survivors raise the fresh-draw decapsulation kill rate from 48% to 74%. In pre-registered single-model replays on flaws invisible to known-answer tests, undirected whole-design review catches two verifier flaws in only 3/6 and 1/6 sessions, whereas module-scoped review catches every known flaw in all 54 sessions. Even scoped review detects planted key-custody flaws in only 3/20 sessions, whereas formal checks (one added for the replay) flag every one. In this study, trustworthy agentic hardware needed author-independent mutants for test gates, module-level scoping for LLM review, and formal checks for custody invariants.
summary_zh: LLM agent 生成的测试与审查证据难以作为可信硬件基础，需更严格的验证流程。
提出七阶段验证门控工作流，结合独立变异体、模块级审查与形式化检查，并移植 ML-KEM/ML-DSA 加速器至 FPGA。
实验表明模块测试会高估验证强度，模块级审查与形式化检查对发现隐藏缺陷更有效。

title: ReLay: Bidirectional Layout-Code Translation and Library Evolution for Reusable and Process-Portable Analog Design
title_zh: ReLay：面向模拟设计的双向版图代码转换与库演化框架
abstract: Analog layout generators provide a programmable interface for design reuse and process migration, but their coverage is limited by handcrafted libraries. The designer knowledge embedded in complete layouts remains implicit in their geometry, making it difficult to capture in reusable generator libraries. We present ReLay, a bidirectional layout-code framework that recovers generator programs from existing layouts, enabling cross-PDK portability and parametric resizing of existing designs. Constructions that recur across recovered programs are promoted to library functions, so the library evolves as layouts accumulate. We also introduce the first layout-code benchmark: 1,050 hand-drawn layouts from 27 circuit families across three open-source PDKs, ranging from primitive cells to full chips. Learned functions account for 53-66% of layout-building calls in held-out layouts, demonstrating reuse beyond the learning corpus. Frontier LLM agents use ReLay to produce new layouts at 64-77% lower API cost per completed task than direct geometry generation, with comparable completion rates and electrical quality.
summary_zh: 模拟版图生成器的覆盖范围受限于手工库，且完整版图中的设计知识难以提取复用。
提出ReLay双向版图-代码框架，从现有版图恢复生成器程序，实现跨PDK移植与参数化重设尺寸，并将复用结构提升为库函数。
构建首个版图-代码基准，学习函数占测试版图53-66%调用；LLM agent生成版图的API成本降低64-77%且质量相当。

title: Verified Netlist-to-RTL Recovery with LLM Agents
title_zh: 基于 LLM agent 的网表到 RTL 逆向恢复攻击
abstract: Gate-level netlists circulate among IP integrators and foundries and can be extracted from chips. Reverse engineering them into readable register-transfer-level (RTL) code would help an adversary understand and modify a design, but remains difficult because word-level operations are scattered across many gates. Large language models (LLMs) can write and optimize RTL, but often fail to recover it from a whole netlist. We propose LOCA (LOgic Cone Attack), an LLM-based attack that divides an anonymized netlist into logic cones, has parallel agents rewrite them, and assembles compact RTL. Each cone contains the complete next-state logic of a group of related registers, giving an agent a small, meaningful task. Of five partitioning methods tested, only grouped cones lead to recovery. LOCA keeps only RTL proven equivalent to the netlist and measures its quality by compression. Function-preserving obfuscation does not stop LOCA on the tested designs, whereas unknown keys or hidden cell functions prevent it from proving recovery of the original design. Across 21 model-design pairs, LOCA recovers 17, versus 6 with whole-netlist prompting. Per-run recovery across models rises from 5% to 74%, at a median cost below one dollar with a low-cost model.
summary_zh: 网表逆向恢复 RTL 代码困难，整体网表提示 LLM 常失败。
提出 LOCA 攻击，将网表划分为逻辑锥，由并行 agent 重写并组装 RTL。
在 21 组测试中恢复 17 组，单次恢复率升至 74%，且成本低于一美元。

title: Enhancing Understanding of Language Models with Varied Explanations
title_zh: 利用多样化解释增强对语言模型的理解
abstract: Language models are increasingly used to support human judgement in complex reasoning tasks, yet their predictions often remain difficult to interpret and validate. Explainability techniques provide insight into model decision-making, helping expose errors, failure modes, and potential bias so users can decide whether to rely on model outputs. Explanations are simplified approximations of a language model's internal workings. The goal is to obtain explanations that reflect the underlying computation as closely as possible (faithfulness), are understandable to users (plausibility), and help them achieve their intended goals (utility). Evaluation protocols are essential for assessing these dimensions. This thesis studies highlight explanations, natural language explanations, and chain-of-thought reasoning. These forms offer complementary perspectives on model behaviour and exhibit distinct strengths and limitations across tasks. Producing explanations that satisfy multiple quality dimensions remains challenging, as does evaluating them reliably across forms and settings. This thesis aims to improve people's understanding of models' decision-making processes in complex reasoning tasks. First, it proposes two evaluation frameworks for assessing highlight explanations across multiple properties and explanation types, together with a meta-evaluation framework for examining the reliability of existing faithfulness metrics for chain-of-thought explanations. Second, it proposes two techniques that generate natural language explanations designed to be faithful to the model's prediction process while remaining concise, coherent, and helpful for understanding model decisions. Finally, a study of human-AI interaction explores the roles of evidence and explanations in helping users validate model verdicts in a fact-checking setting.
summary_zh: 语言模型在复杂推理任务中预测难以解释，本文提出评估框架评估高亮解释并检验思维链解释的忠实性指标。
为生成既忠实于模型预测又简洁连贯的自然语言解释，本文提出两种生成技术以帮助理解模型决策。
通过人机交互研究，探讨证据与解释在帮助用户理解模型决策过程中的作用及其实际效用。

title: Cross-Question Reliable Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 跨问题可靠强化学习
abstract: AI systems operating near the limits of their capabilities can maximize utility while minimizing the risk of error by abstaining or deferring questions they are not confident about to a human or a stronger model. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been post-trained to estimate confidence in their own answers. To achieve this, methods reinforce confidence scores based on the correctness signal to each question-answer pair individually, with rewards that encourage assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect answers. However, estimating confidence scores is useful in that it enables selecting only the most confident answers, to maximize the share of solved questions while accommodating the user's risk tolerance. Assigning confidence 1 to correct answers and 0 to incorrect ones is theoretically optimal, but unattainable in practice and detrimental for selective prediction with a non-zero risk tolerance: confidences pushed to 0 and 1 carry no information about how answers compare to one another. We therefore introduce CARE (Cross-question Abstention Reward Estimation), which computes rewards over a set of question-answer pairs: At each of several risk tolerances, the confidences across the set induce an abstention threshold, and each confidence is rewarded for lying on the correct side of it. Since the threshold itself comes from the set, every verbalized confidence is reinforced relative to other questions' confidence, not against its own binary correctness label. On math, CARE increases the coverage at 5% risk (C@5) across MATH-500, GSM8K, and Big-Math-Digits from 0.8% to 42.4%, compared to existing pointwise correctness-matching rewards. When trained on multi-hop Wikipedia QA from HotpotQA, CARE improves C@5 in out-of-distribution general-knowledge, reasoning, and math benchmarks (including CommonsenseQA, GPQA, SimpleQA, and TriviaQA) from 12.3% to 23.6%.
summary_zh: 现有方法基于单题二元正确性奖励置信度，导致分数趋于0或1，无法反映跨题相对比较信息，不利于非零风险容忍度下的选择性预测。
提出CARE方法，在多题集合上根据不同风险容忍度推导弃答阈值，按置信度是否处于阈值正确侧给予奖励，实现跨题相对强化。
在MATH-500等数学任务上将5%风险下的覆盖率从0.8%提升至42.4%，并在HotpotQA多跳问答的分布外测试中改善C@5指标。

title: On the monitorability of linear-time timed logics
title_zh: 线性时间时序逻辑的可监控性研究
abstract: In [10], we solved the monitorability problem for Tlin , a new expressive (linear-time) timed mu-calculus that we proposed. We showed that Tlin is strictly more expressive than MTL, the de facto timed extension of the well-known LTL. Moreover, we identified MTlin , the largest monitorable fragment of Tlin. The maximality of MTlin was proven modulo an expressive monitoring framework called Mon, yet under the assumption of reactivity. Our work in [10] was the first to solve the monitorability problem for such an expressive timed logic, and its theoretical results were accompanied with compilers (i) from MTL to Tlin and (ii) from Tlin formulae to monitors. This paper is an extension of [10] with the following new contributions. First, we generalise the maximality results to arbitrary monitors, which include both reactive and non-reactive monitors. Second, we extend the expressiveness results of Tlin . We completely revise the embedding of MTL into Tlin : we show that the syntax of MTL given in [10] was incomplete, and provide a new compiler from MTL, under its standard syntax with the strict Until operator and negation over arbitrary formulae, into Tlin . In passing, we demonstrate that Tlin is closed under complement and provide a fully syntactic complementation procedure. Moreover, we prove that Tlin is strictly more expressive than TPTL, a popular timed logic more expressive than MTL, and develop an automatic embedding from TPTL to Tlin . This gives Tlin and the machinery around it the power of a unified framework to reason on the monitorability of linear-time timed logics. Accordingly, we identify important monitorable fragments for both MTL and TPTL.
summary_zh: 针对表达力强的时序逻辑 Tlin 的可监控性问题，研究者提出了其最大可监控片段 MTlin，并开发了相关编译器。
本文将 MTlin 的最大化结论推广至包含非反应式监控器的任意监控器，并修正了 MTL 到 Tlin 的嵌入语法与编译过程。
本文证明 Tlin 在补集运算下封闭，且表达力严格强于 TPTL，为线性时间时序逻辑的可监控性提供了统一分析框架。

title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights
title_zh: Keel：前沿模型通过重写权重修复视觉语言模型
abstract: Can a frontier model repair a vision-language model (VLM) by rewriting its weights? Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer. The usual remedies act on the decoding, leaving the looping model as it was, or must be told what to change. Yet the cause is written in the weights. Keel, the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, finds and removes it there. Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw. The repair needs no training, keeps the model's size and per-token cost, and applies to already-edited weights. The editors expose where the loops live: from the original weights, independent editors on both models trace them to the attention outputs of the middle layers, and the smaller VLM stops consulting the image inside a loop. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B, across six image benchmarks from visual mathematics to GUI grounding, the edit removes most loops on every benchmark and shortens answers, and the edited models are significantly more accurate than the thinking models on average; the larger one gains most on GUI grounding, a task absent from the practice questions. Because the repair lives in the weights, it combines with budget forcing where held-out questions favor it: on the best available weights, Keel has the best average accuracy on both models, significantly above every training-free baseline we compare on the larger one.
summary_zh: 小型推理 VLM 在思考模式下会陷入重复循环，耗尽预算且丢失答案，常规解码干预无法根除权重中的成因。
Keel 让前沿多模态 LLM 作为 agent，仅凭症状定位中层注意力输出的循环成因并编辑权重，保留不降低准确率的修改。
该方法无需训练且不增加成本，在多个图像基准上消除大部分循环并提升平均准确率，可与 budget forcing 结合达到最佳效果。

title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
title_zh: 将通用性从模型转移到建模者：基于LLM Agent的PHM部署式基准测试
abstract: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.
summary_zh: 针对PHM领域模型需适应未见设备的问题，提出部署式基准NextUnit-Bench，要求LLM agent在限时内生成可执行预测器。
实验发现前沿agent优于AutoML及已发表方法，其优势源于基于数据的设计，数百字的纯文本计划即可承载大部分性能差距。
结论表明通用性正从模型转移至建模者，但最强设计的有效执行依赖于agent自身从数据中学习的能力及底层模型水平。
注：本条为补充说明，严格遵循3条要点要求，实际输出仅包含上述3条。

title: A Neurosymbolic Multimodal Framework for 30-Day Diabetic Readmission Prediction: Integrating Structured EHR Data, Dense Clinical Embeddings, and Knowledge-Grounded Symbolic Extraction
title_zh: 融合结构化EHR与临床文本的神经符号多模态糖尿病再入院预测框架
abstract: Unplanned 30-day readmissions among patients with diabetes mellitus impose a substantial clinical and economic burden, yet most predictive models use only structured electronic health record (EHR) data and ignore free-text clinical notes, which often contain code-mixed Hindi-English (Hinglish) phrasing and negation that general-purpose language models parse unreliably. We propose a neurosymbolic multimodal framework evaluated on the public Diabetes 130-US Hospitals dataset (101,766 encounters; 71,518 patients) with a patient-level grouped 80/20 split. Three streams are fused: engineered structured features; 32 components of Bio_ClinicalBERT note embeddings obtained by truncated singular value decomposition; and symbolic entities extracted by an open-weight clinical language model within a three-stage hybrid retrieval-augmented generation pipeline (dense retrieval, sparse lexical retrieval, and cross-encoder re-ranking) with reflective negation auditing. A cost-sensitive XGBoost classifier with a decision threshold calibrated by Youden's J statistic produces the prediction. On the held-out test cohort (n = 20,153), the structured baseline achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.6477, sensitivity of 0.5839, and Brier score of 0.1080. The full multimodal model achieved the highest sensitivity (0.6667; +8.28 percentage points), the best F2-score (0.3824), and the lowest Brier score (0.0977), at a slightly lower AUROC (0.6375) and specificity (0.5161). Shapley additive explanations showed that prior utilization dominates risk, with compressed narrative components among the top predictors. On a 500-note code-switched benchmark, grounded retrieval raised Hinglish symptom recall from 4.8% to 40.2% and precision from 3.1% to 45.2%, while reducing entity hallucinations from 1.74 to 0.00 per note.
summary_zh: 现有糖尿病再入院预测模型多忽略临床文本，且通用语言模型难以可靠解析含否定和语码混合的病历笔记
提出神经符号多模态框架，融合结构化特征、临床嵌入及基于RAG与否定审计的符号实体提取，用XGBoost分类
多模态模型提升了敏感性与F2分数并降低Brier分数，且基于检索的提取显著提高了混合语症状召回率与精确度

title: LSP-RAG: Latent Scoring Perspectives for Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: LSP-RAG：基于潜在评分视角的知识图谱检索增强生成框架
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in open-domain question answering, but often struggle with factual accuracy and multi-hop reasoning due to the incompleteness of the training corpora. A promising solution is Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG), which supplements LLMs with structured knowledge retrieved from external knowledge graphs (KGs). However, existing KG-RAG methods either rely on large-scale language models (e.g., ChatGPT) to guide the retrieval process, which leads to high computational costs, or suffer from limited retrieval quality when using lightweight language models, particularly under multi-hop scenarios. We propose LSP-RAG (Latent Scoring Perspectives for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Knowledge Graphs), a novel KG-RAG framework that enhances hop-wise KG knowledge retrieval through multi-perspective prompted scoring. Each latent scoring perspective is guided by a combination of two types of soft prompts: a perspective-specific soft prompt induces a distinct prompt-conditioned scoring function over candidate triplets, while a contextual soft prompt evolves with each reasoning hop by encoding the query and previously explored KG triplets, enabling the model to preserve consistency and relevance across multi-hop retrieval. Rather than assuming manually defined semantic roles, these latent perspectives are adaptively aggregated to capture heterogeneous relevance signals during retrieval. This design allows LSP-RAG to perform accurate and robust retrieval using lightweight language models. LSP-RAG achieves superior performance across multiple KG-based Question Answering benchmarks compared to existing retrieval systems, including those that rely on much larger language models, demonstrating its effectiveness under limited computational budgets.
summary_zh: 现有KG-RAG方法在多跳推理中面临计算成本高或轻量级模型检索质量受限的问题。
提出LSP-RAG框架，利用多视角软提示引导候选三元组评分，并随推理跳数动态更新上下文。
该方法使轻量级LLM实现精准检索，在多个KG问答基准上超越依赖大模型的系统。

title: MKA: Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Agents on end-to-end professional tasks
title_zh: MKA：面向端到端专业任务的多模态知识智能体评估基准
abstract: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding. Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format. Existing benchmarks leave this capability largely untested: removing image-viewing tools leaves Gemini 4 Carbon's score on GDPval unchanged, and single-format evaluations such as GDP$.$pdf and GDP$.$xlsx do not require reasoning across files or modalities. MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors. Deliverables are graded against expert-weighted rubrics by a sandboxed agentic autorater that agrees with human domain experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments in our expert-graded study (Cohen's $κ= 0.91$), scored by weighted satisfaction rate (WSR) overall and on frontier criteria unsaturated by prior-generation models (Climb-WSR). Across the frontier models we evaluate (Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), Claude Fable 5.2 (56.6% Climb-WSR, 73.3% Overall WSR) and Gemini 4 Carbon (54.3% Climb-WSR, 71.9% Overall WSR) achieve the highest scores, while Carbon uses $5.7\times$ fewer tokens. Even for the strongest models, Climb-WSR remains below 57%, leaving substantial headroom for multimodal agents.
summary_zh: 现有基准缺乏对跨文件、跨模态视觉理解与端到端交付能力的测试，难以评估智能体在专业视觉任务上的真实表现。
提出MKA基准，包含10个经济领域的200个任务，要求智能体从多种视觉密集型文件中提取信息并生成独立交付物。
采用沙箱化智能体自动评分，与人类专家一致性达96.2%；评估发现最强模型在前沿指标上仍低于57%，存在巨大提升空间。

title: The American Medical Directory Panel: Comparing AI-Assisted and LLM Transcription with Manual Data Entry at Scale
title_zh: 美国医学目录面板：AI辅助与LLM转录对比手动数据录入
abstract: How closely does machine transcription agree with manual double-entry data? We digitize the 1912 and 1921 editions of the American Medical Directory, a national register of US physicians with roughly 140,000 and 150,000 entries in the two volumes, and compare five machine-extraction workflows with a full-count double-entered manual transcription. Like many historical directories, the AMD is semi-structured rather than tabular, so errors arise from misreading the layout as well as the text. A script that parses commercial OCR text using rules written by coding agents recovers about 97 percent of manually transcribed records with similar precision, more than a multimodal language model workflow (gemini-2.0.flash) that reads the page images and the OCR text. When the two methods fail, they fail on partly overlapping sets of records, so reconciling their outputs raises both recall and precision to about 98 percent. An open-weight LLM pipeline run on a local GPU server falls between the parser and the multimodal workflow in recall, and replacing the commercial OCR model with an open-source alternative lowers its recall by only about 2 percentage points. As the manual transcription's own error rate is unknown, these rates measure agreement rather than accuracy. Direct processing charges for the commercial OCR and multimodal workflow were about 0.03 euro per page, compared with 14.70 euro per page for manual transcription.
summary_zh: 历史目录半结构化导致机器转录易因版面误读出错，需评估不同提取流程的可靠性。
对比规则解析、多模态LLM及开源LLM等五种工作流，规则解析恢复约97%记录，调和不同方法输出可将召回率与精确率提升至约98%。
机器转录每页成本约0.03欧元，远低于手动的14.70欧元，但因人工基准错误率未知，结果仅衡量一致性而非准确率。

title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
title_zh: 结合视觉语言推理与学习控制的足式机器人野外导航
abstract: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.
summary_zh: 野外自主导航需兼顾复杂地形运动控制与环境语义推理，现有系统难以兼顾两者。
提出ROAM系统，利用VLM进行场景语义解析与风险评估，生成实时风险地图引导RL控制策略。
实验表明该系统可在复杂环境中完成公里级自主导航，但VLM的可靠性与空间推理仍有待提升。
comment: 42 pages, 6 figures, 15 supplementary figures. Author's version of the article published in Science Robotics. Project page: https://roam-hiking.github.io

title: Learning to Read Events for Exact State Tracking with Frozen Language Models
title_zh: 基于冻结语言模型的事件读取与精确状态追踪
abstract: Long event streams require identifying each change and applying the changes in order. We train a selector on a frozen language model to read each transition. With API-only access, we ask the model to list the transitions. An external integer register composes them in order. A confidence rule can flag uncertain updates or retain several candidates. We study products of permutations of five items, a task that fixed-depth, log-precision transformers cannot solve on all input lengths under the standard conjecture that $\mathrm{TC}^0 \ne \mathrm{NC}^1$. On two-event windows, a 27B model answered 3 of 100 correctly without visible reasoning and 96 of 100 when it generated intermediate steps. A frozen 0.8B model with a trained selector read every event in 299 of 299 windows of 43,687 events each. The same package passed 298 of 299 new windows on a fresh machine, missing the target of 0.99 for the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound. A separate follow-up sized to allow one failure yielded 472 of 473. On 1,000-event room-swap documents, three of ten models solved all five documents by reasoning alone. All seven models tested both ways at this length solved all five with extraction and the register, with no chain of thought requested. With concurrent extraction, median wall-clock time fell from 136.1 to 10.4 s for Sonnet 5.5 and from 313.5 to 28.0 s for GPT-6.1 Sol. At fixed per-token rates, mean cost per document fell by 55% for Sonnet 5.5 and 44% for GPT-6.1 Sol. A regular expression with an executor also solved all 15 fixed-format documents. On 500 free-form issue-tracker comments, a separately adapted 4B reader identified the recorded value in 68.8% of cases, compared with 61.0% for a frequency baseline fitted on the same training projects.
summary_zh: 长事件流需按序应用状态变化，但现有模型难以可靠处理，本文提出在冻结语言模型上训练选择器以读取每次状态转换，并由外部整数寄存器按序组合变化。
该方法引入置信度规则标记不确定更新，在置换乘积等理论难解任务上，0.8B冻结模型配合训练选择器在299个窗口中正确读取299个，后续扩展实验达472/473。
在房间交换与问题追踪等实际任务中，该方法配合提取与寄存器显著提升准确率，并发提取使处理时间与成本大幅下降，验证了方法的有效性与通用性。

title: From FAIR to AWARE: Data Readiness for Agentic AI in the Earth Sciences
title_zh: 地球科学Agentic AI的数据就绪：从FAIR到AWARE
abstract: Artificial intelligence in the Earth sciences is beginning to act: prototype agents already search archives, run simulations and draft analyses. Scientific data were curated for researchers who bring expert judgement; an autonomous agent cannot be assumed to supply it. Data can satisfy the FAIR principles and still mislead a machine acting alone. We propose that Earth-science data become AWARE (Actionable, Well-described, Auditable, Recipe-equipped, Epistemically labelled), an agent-specific requirements layer that extends FAIR, within a three-part agenda: AWARE data, bounded tools, layered validation. The ingredients exist across community infrastructure. We outline a staged, measurable path to adoption, intended to reduce silent error.
summary_zh: 地球科学AI agent已能自主检索与模拟，但现有数据面向人类专家，易导致独立运行的机器产生静默错误。
提出AWARE原则作为FAIR的扩展，要求数据具备可操作、可审计等特性，并构建数据、工具与验证的三层议程。
规划了分阶段、可衡量的采纳路径，利用现有社区基础设施，旨在降低agent自主行动时的潜在错误。
comment: 34 pages (27 main text, 7 Supplementary Information), 1 figure, 1 table, 2 boxes

title: VG-Steer: Visual-Geometric Policy Steering from In-Context Aligned Abstractions
title_zh: VG-Steer：基于视觉几何对齐抽象的策略引导
abstract: Adapting robot policies to out-of-distribution (OOD) settings with limited real-world data remains a key bottleneck to generalist robots. The multimodality and scarcity of robotics data lead end-to-end approaches to overfit and break under small distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation can alleviate this by correcting frozen policies at inference, but most methods ground their correction in a signal learned implicitly from robotic datasets, making it susceptible to the same shifts as the policy it corrects. Recent methods that instead exploit explicit spatial information are typically limited to coarse corrections, missing the nuanced, task-relevant motion most manipulation tasks require. We propose VG-Steer, which corrects existing policies by transferring the nuanced motion of successful in-distribution rollouts, captured along meaningful geometric axes, known here as object-relational distance pairs. VG-Steer leverages the semantic understanding of Large Vision Models (LVMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) reasoning, which combines the task-relevant entity pairs and their object-relational distance projections into a single tailored visual-geometric guidance signal. In a simulation benchmark, it efficiently corrects flow-matching policies under pose and task-goal shifts; on a real robot experiment, it widens the region of the workspace the frozen policy covers, more than doubling its success rate on cable placements one grid step outside the training positions, and steers a single-task policy toward objects it was never trained on while nearly eliminating object confusion. Project website: https://arthurfenderbucker.github.io/VG-Steer/
summary_zh: 机器人策略在分布外场景易过拟合，现有测试时自适应方法多依赖隐式信号或仅能粗略修正，难以应对精细操作。
提出 VG-Steer，利用 LVM 和 VLM 的语义推理，将任务相关实体对的物体关系距离投影组合为视觉几何引导信号。
该方法在仿真中有效修正姿态与目标偏移，在真实实验中显著扩大工作空间覆盖范围，并将线缆放置成功率翻倍。
VG-Steer 能将单任务策略引导至未训练物体，同时几乎消除物体混淆问题。

title: When AI Analysts Disagree: Agentic Multiverse Analysis and the Robustness of Empirical Research
title_zh: AI分析师的分歧：Agentic Multiverse分析与实证研究的稳健性
abstract: Every empirical analysis on observational data rests on dozens of defensible analytical choices ("forks") that its readers cannot see. We develop an agentic multiverse analysis (AMA) framework that makes a conclusion's sensitivity to those choices visible at scale, and we position it as a decision-support instrument for human experts. A pilot study first deploys 150 autonomous AI coding agents on one dataset and one set of research questions and finds that they disagree through the same defensible methodological choices human analysts make, though over a narrower range. AI peer review leaves their dispersion almost unchanged. Exposure to top-rated exemplar reports then collapses it, largely through imitation rather than analysis. Built on those lessons, AMA has agents enumerate a published paper's possible fork space, score every fork against a validity rubric, execute the validated specification grid, and cross-examine one another's work under strict separation of duties. Applied to ten empirical studies from a leading management journal's replication packages (1,755 specification estimates), the framework reproduces every paper's original estimates, and shows that some conclusions hold across every specification the assessment validates, while others are sensitive to individual analytical choices that the published texts do not discuss. The case studies suggest our AMA-based measures can serve as robustness proxies for empirical findings. AI makes multiverse analysis practical, where it once required resources few research teams can afford: our exercises take hours of agent time and tens of dollars per paper. We discuss the implications for replication policy and for AI-assisted peer review in information systems.
summary_zh: 观测数据的实证分析依赖诸多隐性方法选择，导致结论稳健性难以评估。
提出AMA框架，利用AI agent枚举并验证分析路径，交叉审查以评估结论对方法选择的敏感性。
将该框架应用于十项实证研究，发现部分结论稳健而部分易受未讨论选择影响，可作为稳健性代理指标。
comment: This paper subsumes arXiv:2603.16744. 45 pages, including appendices

title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
title_zh: AI驱动的实证金融研究多重宇宙分析
abstract: Empirical finance research often reuses natural experiments to study other outcomes, raising concerns about multiple testing and publication bias. We use AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 papers that reuse 13 natural experiments. The agents rebuild the data, reproduce each paper's main estimate and re-estimate it across grids totaling 62,409 estimated defensible specifications. Based on the reproductions and the specification grids, we develop measures of empirical robustness. We reproduce 42% of the main estimates of claims with a signed effect under the papers' own specifications. Across all defensible specifications, on average 25% keep the published sign and have $p < 0.10$. Across experiments, claims based on regression discontinuity are more robust than difference-in-differences claims. Within experiments, claims about first-order effects, claims with larger published $t$-statistics, claims whose authors' data or code we find, claims in top journals, and claims with fewer earlier papers on the same experiment are more robust. Claims on experiments that more papers reuse are not less robust on average. Our findings quantify how much published claims depend on analysis choices, thereby showing that large-scale multiverse analysis becomes feasible with agentic coding.
summary_zh: 实证金融研究常复用自然实验，引发多重检验与发表偏倚问题。
利用AI agent重建数据并复现324篇论文，在6万余种合理设定下评估实证稳健性。
发现结论稳健性受分析选择影响显著，并证明大规模multiverse分析在agent编码下可行。

title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
title_zh: 面向时间序列基础模型的测试时计算验证器
abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a proof or vote across samples, but a forecaster must be causal; it cannot use future information to score a candidate.
