summary_zh: 现有自主agent常仅以最终得分评价，忽略了编辑权限、失败试验处理及决策溯源等过程问题。
提出构建受治理的实验框架，由控制面管理试验生命周期、校验编辑范围并记录至不可篡改账本。
在六项任务中验证表明，该账本暴露了得分掩盖的失败，且在对照实验中完整记录了所有试验。
comment: 22 pages. Presented at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI (ETAAI; non-archival). Code and trial ledgers: https://github.com/dowlingwong/autoresearch_harness (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24174991)

title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
title_zh: 更简洁的微型递归模型
abstract: Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on slow-updating channels only. We test STRM on Sudoku-Extreme, PPBench and Maze-Hard with the same data, parameters and compute as TRM: we improve over TRM by $3.8$ points on Sudoku-Extreme and $8.4$ points on PPBench and match it on Maze-Hard. On ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2, STRM improves over the published TRM results by $5.4$ and $0.5$ points. We will release our code upon acceptance of the paper.
summary_zh: 现有 TRM 为避免过拟合采用复杂嵌套循环与多状态机制，增加了实现难度。
提出 STRM，采用单一状态与统一更新，结合指数滑动更新和慢速通道读取方案。
在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下提升训练速度与性能，在多个推理基准上显著优于 TRM。

title: Lodestone: Automated Semantic Discovery of Datacenter Hardware Specialization
title_zh: Lodestone：数据中心硬件专用化的自动语义发现
abstract: Hardware specialization can improve datacenter efficiency. Unfortunately, identifying computations that justify dedicated hardware is difficult. Existing approaches analyze hot functions, instruction patterns, or overheads such as datacenter tax. They can miss fine-grained computations whose aggregate cost is spread across applications and libraries, especially when different pieces of code obscure the same underlying computation. We observe that seemingly unrelated code regions often perform the same computations, creating specialization opportunities that require semantic reasoning. The rise of agentic AI makes it possible to automate this. However, conventional AI agents cannot efficiently and reliably analyze large scale datacenter software. To unlock this opportunity, we present Lodestone, an agentic framework that automatically discovers hardware specialization opportunities by reasoning about what the executed code computes. First, Lodestone extracts hot control-flow regions from execution traces across workloads and organizes them into compact analysis packages that make large workloads tractable for agents. Second, agents describe what each region computes, merge those that perform the same computation into computational families, and check their semantic correctness in a loop. Third, to verify the discovered family, Lodestone runs every piece of code in a family against a set of reference inputs and outputs on recorded executions. Finally, for selected families, Lodestone proposes hardware, e.g., ISA extensions, near-core units, or detached accelerators, and human experts decide which proposals to develop further. We evaluate Lodestone on 20 workloads across six datacenter workload categories. We simulate 30 discovered families in a cycle-accurate simulator and implement them in RTL. These optimizations speed up the workloads by 12.6% on average and by up to 80.2%.
summary_zh: 现有方法难以发现分散在不同代码中且底层计算相同的细粒度硬件专用化机会。
提出基于 agentic AI 的框架 Lodestone，提取热点控制流区域并交由 agent 进行语义推理与合并。
在20个负载上验证有效，能自动发现计算族并生成硬件加速提案供专家决策。

title: Polymorph: Operating System Kernel Optimization Through Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: Polymorph：基于AI的操作系统内核优化方法
abstract: While popular operating systems such as Linux and Windows were originally designed as monolithic kernels, an increasing number of kernel subsystems have become extensible using eBPF. Users can now define custom policies for essential kernel mechanisms, such as the process scheduler, page cache, and network stack, without recompiling the kernel. These mechanisms give developers significant freedom to fit the kernel to their applications' workloads, but the question of which policy to deploy remains open. We study how to use agentic AI to automate kernel policy development, selection, and deployment, focusing on the page cache and the process scheduler as two representative subsystems. We show that existing approaches fall short: evolutionary and agentic search runs offline, is relatively expensive, and often fails to generalize to online workloads, while online knob tuners are encumbered by the knobs' lack of expressivity. In contrast, we propose Polymorph, which learns online: an AI agent writes a generalized, granular policy once, and a user mode tuner adjusts its parameters during runtime, with no LLM in the loop. For the page cache, Polymorph improves throughput over Linux's LRU by 8.4% on unseen data, nearly twice the gain of the best existing policy, while adapting to workload changes at runtime and costing only 16M tokens once, versus 125-240M tokens per workload for agentic offline search. For the process scheduler, it improves on Linux's default by 2.75x across six workloads, versus 2.27x for the best fixed sched_ext policy.
summary_zh: 现有内核策略优化方法难以适应在线负载，离线搜索成本高且泛化差，在线调参表达力不足。
提出Polymorph，由AI agent一次性生成通用策略，运行时由用户态调参器调整参数，无需LLM在线参与。
在页缓存和进程调度子系统中，该方法显著提升吞吐量，且大幅降低token消耗并适应运行时负载变化。

title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair
title_zh: 视觉语言模型权重空间编程修复研究
abstract: In weight-space programming, a language model edits a network's weights directly, without gradients. We ask what a successful repair of this kind relies on. We plant faults in the weights of two vision-language models, SmolVLM-256M and LFM2-VL-450M, and check each edit made by a coding agent against the original weights. Without being told where to look, the agent finds rescaled rows in the projector and noise in the vision encoder of both models, infers the unknown scale factors, restores most or all of the rescaled weights to their exact original values, and returns accuracy to near its original level; programs that it writes from such weights repair unseen checkpoints of the same model without feedback. These repairs depend on a trace of how the faults were computed. The original weights have 16-bit precision, and faults computed in 32-bit arithmetic leave low bits that only the damaged weights carry. Rounding those bits away leaves each model's answers to our test questions unchanged, and the agent, unaided, then restores no weight exactly: on SmolVLM it no longer finds the damage, and in a single session on LFM2-VL its only gain comes from rescaling answer-token embeddings, which changes how often the model answers yes. Marking the damaged weights again in their low bits brings the edits back to them. Rounded weights still hold statistical evidence of the rescaling, in the distribution of stored values and in row norms, and one sentence in the prompt that names such a statistic directs the agent's edits to the damaged rows on both models. Swapped rows or columns, which leave the set of stored values unchanged, are not found unaided on either model within our session budgets. We recommend that studies of weight repair report the number format of the weights and include a rounded control.
summary_zh: 问题：探究语言模型直接编辑网络权重进行修复的可靠性依赖条件。方法：在SmolVLM等模型植入故障，由agent自主定位并修复。结论：agent能恢复权重并复原精度，但高度依赖故障计算留下的低位痕迹。
问题：当抹除权重中携带的低位痕迹后，agent能否继续实现修复。方法：将权重舍入以消除低位痕迹，观察agent的修复行为。结论：agent无法精确定位损伤，仅能通过调整token嵌入改变回答频率，修复失效。
问题：消除痕迹后是否存在其他线索引导修复。方法：分析权重统计分布，并在提示词中提供行范数等统计线索。结论：统计线索能引导agent定位受损行，但无法发现不改变数值分布的行列交换故障。

title: MANGO Arena: Same Seeds, Different Chains Evaluating LLM Agents in a Disrupted Supply Chain
title_zh: MANGO Arena：评估供应链中LLM agent的测试平台
abstract: We introduce MANGO Arena, an open-source testbed in which four LLM agents each run one company in a serial supply chain adapted from MANGO, a classroom factory-management game. The environment enforces hard rules (a truck limit, a no-credit cash constraint and production capacity), logs every blocked attempt to break them, and gives agents a public message board on which side payments are explicitly forbidden. This lets one environment measure three things at once: an economic outcome (the bullwhip effect), rule adherence under pressure, and proposals to collude. In a pilot with three small reasoning models, two scripted reference policies, two conditions (with and without a supplier fire) and three demand seeds, all LLM agents amplified demand variability as it moved upstream, by 7 to 25 times at the Retailer and 13 to 179 times at the Supplier, often more than a textbook order-up-to policy. They did so largely by ordering in batches (zero orders in up to 60% of decisions). Real rule violations were rare (at most 7 of 288 decisions per model) and no agent proposed a money side deal. The pilot's main lesson concerns evaluation method. API failures (rate limits and runaway hidden reasoning) entered the metrics silently as "no order" decisions. And when we reran games with the same seeds and no failed calls, upstream bullwhip changed by up to 17 times between runs. With three seeds, conclusions about how a disruption affects a given model did not survive a rerun. We report these failures in full and propose reporting practices for multi-agent evaluations of this kind. Code, prompts and every logged decision are public.
summary_zh: 针对供应链中LLM agent评估缺乏统一环境的问题，构建MANGO Arena测试平台，同时测量经济结果、规则遵守与合谋行为。
初步实验发现，LLM agent因批量下单显著放大需求波动，但极少违反规则，也未提出金钱私下交易。
评估方法上，API失败会静默影响指标，且相同种子重跑结果差异巨大，据此提出多agent评估的规范报告实践。

title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
title_zh: ARISE：面向企业Agent的自进化记忆架构
abstract: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $τ^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $τ^2$-bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on $τ^2$-bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).
summary_zh: 企业LLM agent面临模型迭代快且需兼顾准确率与成本的动态环境问题，提出ARISE记忆架构，通过自身失败经验实现无需更新权重的自我进化。
利用模型自身或教师模型分析失败原因并生成修正，将其存为可检索的微记忆并整合为宏观规则，仅在验证准确率提升时才接受规则更新。
在多个基准测试中，ARISE显著提升了准确率并优于现有方法，同时减少了模型调用次数和输出token，实现了高准确率与低成本的有效平衡。

title: Receiver-Conditioned Clarification for Multi-Agent Food Assistance
title_zh: 面向多智能体食物援助的接收者条件化澄清框架
abstract: Food insecurity creates a pressing need for guidance that helps households find usable food resources and assess food choices in light of their circumstances. Such guidance must connect eligibility requirements, practical access constraints, and dietary needs rather than return isolated listings or generic nutritional advice. Multi-agent food assistants can coordinate these tasks, with uncertainty indicating when clarification or verification is needed before a recommendation. However, uncertainty can be lost across agent handoffs, allowing tentative interpretations to propagate as facts and obscuring opportunities for correction. Moreover, confidence that a service requirement has been interpreted correctly is not confidence that a recommendation satisfies the user's needs; local confidence cannot simply be reused as downstream reliability. We introduce an inference-time, receiver-conditioned clarification framework that preserves shared premise identities and replays consistent interpretations across dependent agents. Each receiver exposes admissible decisions and remaining evidence obligations, so question relevance reflects both decision changes and missing support. Information questions and user-confirmable fallback adjustments are evaluated together with their anticipated follow-up interactions under shared budgets. This structure connects clarification to jointly supported plans for resource navigation, nutritional reasoning, and supply-side planning.
summary_zh: 多智能体食物援助系统在交接时易丢失不确定性，导致初步解释被误作事实传播，且局部置信度无法直接作为下游可靠性。
提出推理时的接收者条件化澄清框架，保留共享前提身份并在依赖智能体间重放一致解释，各接收者暴露可行决策与证据义务。
将信息提问与用户可确认的回退调整结合评估，使澄清与资源导航、营养推理等联合支持计划相联系。

title: Safe to Omit, Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Another's Message
title_zh: 多智能体系统中安全省略消息以降低延迟的机制
abstract: In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent's message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle's gain. Second, whether a message can be skipped depends on how often and how predictably it alters the answer, not on its accuracy; every certified KV-cache path is less accurate than the receiver agent alone. Third, where text messages help, skipping keeps most of their gain: on unseen questions in the four such settings, the policies skip 59 to 80% and keep an estimated 76 to 95% of the gain. In two prospective tests with all rules fixed in advance, our mechanism skips a three-agent system's verifier on 39.9% of sealed questions, keeping 12.55 of its 12.80-point gain, and a 32B helper on 68.4% of held-out questions, keeping its whole gain. Fourth, safety does not determine efficiency: at batch size one, skipping text saves hundreds of milliseconds per query and skipping KV cache far less. Certification extends to SQuAD but not to GSM8K. In eleven tests on unseen questions, every certified policy we could test kept its change rate's 95% upper bound below 5% under our answer parsers.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统中接收者等待辅助消息会增加延迟，需判断何时可安全省略且节省时间大于决策成本。
提出基于接收者置信度的有限样本测试机制，在无消息时认证阈值，确保高概率下省略消息后答案改变率不超过5%。
实验表明该机制在多数场景下可省略大量消息并保留大部分性能增益，但安全性与效率不完全对应，且不适用于GSM8K。

title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
title_zh: LProp：基于潜在不确定性传播的LLM Agent信念修正方法
abstract: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token usage in all eight propagation settings. Matched feature ablations further demonstrate that inherited latent content improves error recovery beyond answer probabilities or model capacity alone.
summary_zh: LLM agent在传递中间判断时忽略不确定性，易将假设误认为事实，而现有标量或反思方法存在信息丢失或成本过高问题。
提出潜在不确定性估计器与LProp方法，利用潜在表示和新证据修正继承的答案分布，无需额外轨迹采样。
实验表明该方法在多数指标上优于基线，在所有八种传播设置中推理token消耗最低，且能有效提升错误恢复能力。

title: Towards Fair Resource Sharing in Agentic LLM Serving
title_zh: 面向智能体LLM服务的公平资源共享框架
abstract: As LLM agents increasingly execute complex, multi-step tasks on shared inference infrastructure, resource contention across the end-to-end LLM serving stack causes severe and uneven slowdowns across agents. Existing agentic serving systems primarily optimize throughput and latency, with comparatively limited attention to fairness among concurrent agents. Although fairness has been studied in conventional LLM serving at the token and request levels, these approaches do not fully capture cumulative delays and stateful resource dependencies across successive LLM calls within an agent. Moreover, interference spans request routing, runtime scheduling, and hardware resources, making agent-level fairness challenging to define and optimize across an end-to-end serving stack. This paper presents a cross-layer framework to define agent-level fairness, attribute sources of unfairness, and optimize fairness while preserving throughput. To account for agents with widely varying execution demands, we build a theoretical foundation to define fairness using slowdown relative to standalone execution. Our empirical analysis reveals that routing, runtime scheduling, and hardware contention jointly determine fairness, with performance-oriented policies often leading to prolonged queuing delays. To optimize fairness, we introduce Duru, which monitors each agent's slowdown and uses this signal to guide admission and scheduling decisions across the router and runtime. Duru further alleviates starvation through admission exceptions and integrates slowdown-driven autoscaling to adhere to Service-Level Objectives (SLOs). Our evaluation across various benchmarks and hardware platforms shows that Duru reduces 99th-percentile normalized slowdown by a geometric mean of 44.4% (up to 79.5%) while delivering 91.8-127.4% of the state-of-the-art system's throughput.
summary_zh: 多智能体在共享LLM推理基础设施上执行多步任务时，跨端到端服务栈的资源竞争会导致严重且不均衡的延迟，而现有系统缺乏对并发智能体公平性的关注。
现有请求级或token级公平性方法无法捕捉智能体连续调用间的累积延迟与状态依赖，本文提出跨层框架，基于相对独立执行的减速来定义和归因智能体级公平性。
本文提出Duru系统，通过监控智能体减速信号指导路由与运行时调度，结合准入异常与自动扩缩容缓解饥饿并保障SLO，将99分位减速降低44.4%。

title: Beyond the Sink Token: Sink-Guided Key Editing in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 超越 Sink Token：视觉语言模型中的 Sink 引导键编辑方法
abstract: In vision-language models (VLMs), a few sink tokens attract a disproportionate share of attention. While previous studies have examined why these tokens attract attention, we investigate how the sink-key direction affects attention to image and question tokens. Across four probed VLMs, boosting the magnitude of positive sink-aligned components increases attention on average, whereas boosting negative components decreases it; these responses persist through later layers. This identifies the native sink key as a reference for controlling attention beyond its own position. Motivated by this finding, we propose SHRINK, a training-free method that partially reduces sink-aligned components across visible keys during generation. On nine benchmarks under sampled reasoning, it improves mean accuracy by 5.1 and 2.7 percentage points on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B, with smaller gains on the other two main models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Gemma-3-4B. Beyond SHRINK, rescaling sink-aligned key components can replace the attention operations of two existing attention-steering methods, GIFT and ACG, with comparable accuracy on hallucination benchmarks.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型中 sink token 会过度吸引注意力，但其 sink-key 方向如何影响图像与问题 token 的注意力尚不明确。
研究发现调整 sink 对齐的键分量能控制注意力，据此提出无需训练的 SHRINK 方法，在生成时部分缩减可见键的 sink 对齐分量。
在九个基准测试中，SHRINK 提升了模型平均准确率，且该缩放机制可替代现有注意力引导方法 GIFT 和 ACG。

title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
title_zh: GRAFT：基于执行引导的遗传重组 agent 设计方法
abstract: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82.0%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.8% points. Controlled ablations show that adding execution evidence improves test accuracy with initialization, search rules, repair policies, and evaluation budgets held fixed. Our results support the value of parent-specific execution evidence for evolutionary agent design.
summary_zh: 自动化 agent 设计的进化方法仅依赖聚合适应度，掩盖了每次运行的具体成败细节。
提出 GRAFT 方法，利用父代执行证据引导语义交叉与变异，无需额外任务执行或参考答案。
在六项推理与编程任务中平均测试准确率达 82.0%，较最强基线提升 9.8 个百分点。

title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
title_zh: BOS Summary：让首个 Token 携带输入上下文
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.
summary_zh: LVLM 和 LLM 存在注意力汇聚现象，但因果掩码下 BOS token 无法获取输入信息，导致后续访问缺乏上下文。
提出 BOS Summary 方法，在预填充阶段放松 BOS 的因果约束，使其聚合所有输入 token 形成上下文表征。
该方法无需训练且无额外开销，在多个基准上提升推理效果，并促使注意力重新分配至内容 token。

title: ACaM: Automated Capability Modeling for Agentic AI Security
title_zh: 面向智能体AI安全的自动化能力建模方法ACaM
abstract: In agentic AI systems, an LLM invokes tools that hold standing access to credentials, private data, filesystems, and external services. Such agents are increasingly deployed without an answer to a basic question: what can an agent access, exfiltrate, and propagate, independent of what it is designed for or is observed to do? The question goes unanswered because existing approaches trust a tool's natural-language description as a proxy for its behavior. But nothing enforces that the description and its implementation agree. This gap is known as Description-Code Inconsistency (DCI). DCI enables a threat class called capability laundering, in which a tool's implementation contains dangerous behavior that its description omits. The behavior may come from incidental drift or a supply-chain compromise. It runs silently whenever an LLM invokes the tool for its stated, benign purpose. We present ACaM, a neurosymbolic approach to capability modeling that derives each tool's capabilities from its code, so a laundered capability cannot hide behind a benign description. In ACaM, static analysis grounds an LLM in code-derived facts, and no LLM output can override a fact that static analysis has established. The LLM supplies only the behavioral meaning that those facts cannot express. ACaM compiles agent source code into the Agent Capability Property Graph (ACPG) and uses it to reconstruct threat chains that span multiple tool calls. We evaluate ACaM on 43 real-world agents, including 9 multi-agent systems. On 24 manually annotated agents, it recovers capability properties with 98.3% macro-F1 and reconstructs injected threat chains with a score of 0.980, 8 points above the strongest baseline. Applied to all 43 unmodified agents, it discovers hundreds of structural vulnerabilities, ten of which we confirm with proof-of-concept exploits.
summary_zh: 智能体AI存在描述与代码不一致（DCI）问题，导致工具可能隐藏危险行为，引发“能力洗白”威胁。
提出ACaM方法，结合静态分析与LLM从代码中提取能力事实，确保LLM无法覆盖已确立的事实。
在43个真实智能体上评估，ACaM以高准确率恢复能力属性并重构威胁链，发现数百个结构漏洞。

title: MedHarness: A Unified Budgeted Runtime for Reliable Medical Imaging Agents
title_zh: MedHarness：面向医学影像 agent 的统一预算运行时
abstract: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MedHarness-paper-release-A7F3/.
summary_zh: 医学影像 agent 部署面临验证预算受限且跨模态缺乏共享控制器的问题，导致错误接受难以避免。
提出 MedHarness 可靠性层，将预测后控制转化为共享决策对象，通过统一策略与适配器实现跨模态控制。
在 512 例测试中，该方法将错误接受降低约 47%，接受准确率提升至 83.2%，并显著减少远程服务调用。

title: Encapsulating Reactive Behaviour in Goal-based Plans for Programming BDI Agents
title_zh: 将反应式行为封装到BDI agent的基于目标的计划中
abstract: Reactive behaviour in BDI-based models and architectures adopted in agent programming is typically specified in terms of reactive plans not bound to any specific goal. In this paper, we present and discuss an extension of the plan model used in BDI programming languages in which goal-based plans encapsulate both proactive and reactive behaviour. This brings important benefits both to the practice of agent programming and in supporting agent reasoning at runtime. The paper first introduces the model formally, abstracting away from particular programming languages. The approach is then evaluated through concrete implementations based on two existing agent programming platforms, namely Jason and ASTRA. The paper reports on experiments showing that the approach provides for elegant programming and can also be efficient.
summary_zh: 传统BDI模型的反应式行为独立于目标，缺乏统一管理机制。
提出扩展计划模型，使基于目标的计划同时封装主动与反应式行为。
在Jason和ASTRA平台验证表明，该方法编程优雅且运行高效。

title: Foundation Model-Driven Agentic AI for 6G
title_zh: 面向6G的基础模型驱动智能体AI框架
abstract: Mobile networks are outgrowing manual tuning: parameters multiply, services diversify, and traffic shifts faster than experts can react. The machine learning (ML) models that automate radio control are narrow: each is trained for one task, degrades when conditions move, and needs specialist retraining. This article introduces FM-in-the-loop, a framework for 6G radio access networks in which a foundation model (FM) reasons while lightweight machine learning agents act. It reads operator intents in plain language, decomposes them into subtasks, coordinates task-specific agents over Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, and supervises them across their lifecycle---while the orchestration FM never enters the latency-critical control path. We locate seven integration points across four lifecycle stages, compare three cloud-to-edge deployments, and evaluate two elements: channel representations from a wireless FM are tested under noise-level and channel-estimation-error shift, and an instrumented emulation of the orchestration loop reports the measured cost of turning an operator intent into dispatched agent goals. Hallucination, cost, and standardization barriers remain.
summary_zh: 现有移动网络ML模型任务单一且需专家重训，难以应对快速变化的网络环境。
提出FM-in-the-loop框架，由FM解析意图并协调轻量级agent，自身不进入低延迟控制路径。
评估了无线FM表征与编排循环，验证了可行性，并指出幻觉、成本及标准化挑战。

title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
title_zh: SpecLook：面向快速可靠智能体MLLM的推测式视觉定位框架
abstract: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.
summary_zh: 现有Agentic MLLM交替推理与放大工具调用的串行循环速度慢，且答案缺乏可靠性评分。
提出无训练的SpecLook框架，利用小模型推测并验证下一观测，避免运行完整循环。
实验表明该方法在所有数据集上均优于基线，实现更高准确率与数倍加速。

title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
title_zh: GUARD：基于遗憾引导的递归自我改进稳定化框架
abstract: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.
summary_zh: 自主 AI agent 的递归自我改进（RSI）在无外部评分器时，常因自我编辑导致局部退化、技能遗忘和内存膨胀。
提出 GUARD 闭环框架，将任务分解为执行前自检，利用方向性遗憾引导更新，并通过无批评家的相对适应度选择候选编辑。
引入 Soft-HURT 门控机制确保改进收益大于退化，实验表明该方法能持续提升性能且无灾难性遗忘，大幅降低部署 token 消耗。
comment: Equal contribution: Minghe Zhang and Xuetao Kang. 38 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables

title: Reliability by Architecture: Agentic Workflows for Validated Multi-Physics Simulation from Natural Language
title_zh: 基于架构可靠性的多物理场仿真 agentic workflow
abstract: Preparing, executing, and validating strongly coupled multi-physics simulations require expert time. Agentic workflows use large language models (LLMs) to coordinate them from natural-language descriptions, but reliability requires checks of physical consistency and fidelity to the problem description. Our agentic harness implements explicit task allocation: LLMs interpret user requests and simulator diagnostics, generate input components not covered by predefined construction rules, and propose repairs, while deterministic routines construct supported components and check inputs, edits, and results. We evaluate CO2-storage problems using the multi-physics simulator GEOS, from compositional flow to flow-poromechanics with frictional fault contact. In 80 attempts on two flow problems, grounding raises the proportion of structurally valid inputs from 5/20 to 20/20, but acceptance reaches 20/20 only with complete rule-based input preparation. With identical inputs, local repairs correct three seeded defects while preserving valid inputs. Supporting tests identify simulations passing physics checks despite differing from the problem description or reference results.
summary_zh: 多物理场仿真依赖专家且自然语言驱动 LLM 缺乏可靠性，需引入物理一致性校验。
采用 LLM 解释请求与诊断并生成非预定义组件，结合确定性程序构建受支持组件并校验输入与结果。
在 CO2 封存仿真测试中，grounding 与规则化输入准备显著提升有效输入比例，局部修复可纠正缺陷。

title: QCCDCert: Formally Verified Compilation for QCCD Co-Design
title_zh: QCCDCert：面向QCCD协同设计的形式化验证编译
abstract: Quantum charge-coupled device (QCCD) architectures enable scalable trapped-ion quantum computing by dynamically shuttling ions between specialized processing and storage zones. A QCCD can be built with many trap sizes and layouts. Comparing them requires compiling every program under each design's transport, capacity and control constraints, and trusting the target code of each compilation. We present a co-design framework built on one Lean-verified compiler. The hardware description and its operating rules are compiler inputs, so a single theorem covers every candidate design: the target code of every compilation preserves its program's behavior and obeys the hardware rules. Across 75 benchmark programs of 11 to 130 qubits, the best design found takes 66% less modeled execution time on average than the worst design of equal capacity. An AI agent that proposes devices based on our compiler's checked results beats the fastest of these designs on 71 of 75 programs. Our verified compiler provably avoids the 11 defects that we report in three previous compilers. It scales to hundreds of qubits, compiling 512-qubit programs for a 38-trap device in 1 to 29 minutes.
summary_zh: 现有QCCD架构设计对比需依赖编译并信任目标代码，易产生缺陷
提出基于Lean验证的协同设计框架，单一定理保证编译保持程序行为且遵循硬件规则
该编译器可扩展至数百量子比特，结合AI代理能进一步优化设备设计并提升执行效率

title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
title_zh: VeriMath：人机协同的课标对齐数学测评题生成与验证框架
abstract: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. Across two model backbones, the framework produces verifier-accepted drafts for 94% (47/50) of requirements per run. Blind expert evaluations confirm high mathematical accuracy and curriculum alignment, with strict teacher-readiness assessments accepting up to 56.8% of generated items. Analysis of rejected drafts reveals persistent domain-agnostic challenges involving formatting, statement validity, and solution-step completeness. These findings demonstrate that VeriMath can bridge generative AI and dependable educational applications by producing highly reviewable assessment drafts within tightly constrained national curriculum frameworks.
summary_zh: 数学题自动生成需兼顾正确性、课标对齐与难度控制，但现有方法缺乏对题型格式的精细控制与专家审核支持。
提出人机协同框架VeriMath，基于参考题锚定题型与认知层级，经自动验证与引导修复后提交专家审核。
在越南课标数据上验证，94%的生成需求产出合格草稿，专家盲评确认其高准确性与课标对齐度。

title: Folded out-of-time-order correlators in double-scaled SYK
title_zh: 双标度SYK模型中的折叠OTOC与反 scrambling
abstract: Harlow and Zhao arXiv:2607.14215 have identified ``anti-scrambling'' as a characteristic signature of cosmological horizons in de Sitter space, and proposed that it can be realized in a quantum system with bounded energy by Euclidean time ``folding" of out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs). We implement this prescription in the DSSYK model. We use arXiv:2303.03474 to define an infinite-temperature ($β=0$) DSSYK OTOC that in the semiclassical limit of small values of the double-scaling parameter $λ$ reproduces the usual AdS eikonal shockwave behavior with its characteristic time delay, and then apply the Harlow-Zhao fold with the ``fake'' DSSYK inverse temperature $β_f$ playing the role of $β$. We demonstrate both numerically and analytically that the resulting folded OTOC displays anti-scrambling. The exact DSSYK evaluation tracks the semiclassical de Sitter eikonal formula in the scrambling regime, including a time advance instead of a time delay.The direction of the fold selects the side from which the continued eikonal amplitude approaches its branch cut. We show how our results are consistent with recent ``no-go" constraints. We compare the folded correlator with the two-shell analysis of arXiv:2607.14215: the growing term of the two-shell dilaton invariant appears in DSSYK with the same exponent, but as an imaginary part, while its real part, which would signal the backreaction that ends in a crunch, only moves by $O(λ)$ for thermal-scale probes. We also generalize to finite $β$; we find reasonable agreement with the de Sitter eikonal form for sufficiently high temperatures, but at lower temperatures the folded correlator is dominated by a pair of complex conjugate saddles, an anti-Stokes crossover that prevents retrieval of the eikonal behavior from the folded OTOC.
summary_zh: de Sitter宇宙学视界具有反scrambling特征，需在有界能量系统中通过欧氏时间折叠OTOC来实现
在DSSYK模型中定义无穷温OTOC并应用Harlow-Zhao折叠，解析与数值验证其呈现反scrambling
折叠关联子在高湿下符合de Sitter eikonal形式，低温下由复共轭鞍点主导，且结果符合no-go约束

title: When Does Subspace Direction Matter for LoRA? Regime Analysis of the Magnitude Principle in Few-Shot Adaptation
title_zh: 少样本适配中LoRA的子空间方向何时起作用：幅度原理的机制分析
abstract: We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful. A spiked-covariance perturbation analysis characterizes the finite-sample stability of the estimated subspace. A first-step analysis of LoRA training explains why the subspace's alignment with the task matters and motivates an alignment coefficient $ρ$ that closely tracks gains across classification tasks. We test this account with PivotLoRA, which initializes adapters from activation PCA at prediction-relevant positions and applies one output-preserving orthogonal pivot early in training. In few-shot BERT-base classification, PivotLoRA achieves the best average rank among 13 methods and improves over vanilla LoRA in 29 of 30 settings, even though it starts from a smaller input-factor initialization norm. Additional classification experiments extend the evaluation to 7B and 8B Llama decoders. Classification gains diminish with more labeled data, consistent with the proposed regime dependence. A targeted extension to completion-only reasoning also shows improvements on GSM8K and StrategyQA. These findings identify conditions under which initialization direction matters, with subspace-task alignment offering a low-cost diagnostic before training for classification.
summary_zh: 针对LoRA初始化方向重要性存在争议的问题，通过理论与实验分析发现其取决于数据稀缺程度及子空间与任务的对齐情况。
提出对齐系数ρ并设计PivotLoRA方法，利用预测相关位置的激活PCA初始化并在训练初期施加正交变换。
实验表明PivotLoRA在少样本分类中优于多种方法，且在推理任务上亦有提升，验证了方向有效性的条件。
随着标注数据增多，分类增益逐渐减弱，证实了初始化方向重要性的机制依赖特性，子空间对齐可作为低成本诊断指标。
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 43 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/Nischal1011/pivotlora

title: Record Sufficiency: What a Decision Record Must Preserve When an Unsettled Claim Becomes an Operative Status
title_zh: 决策记录充分性：未定声明转为生效状态时的留存要求
abstract: Organisations keep evidence, logs and approvals, but often not the step by which an unsettled claim became an operative status, such as an accepted label or a released image, so later readers cannot tell what the status was allowed to mean. We call a decision record sufficient if it is true and a reader who has only the record and the items it cites can explain the status, bound it, re-derive it and challenge it. From these four uses we argue for ten questions a record must answer, map them onto the author's earlier JSON Schema for decision records (DRK v0.1), and define four mechanical checks. We separate conformance, which the checks decide; adequacy, whether the answers are specific enough to use, which needs a reader; fidelity, which no check on the record decides; and merits, which sufficiency does not require. On 164 single-defect variants of three synthetic records, schema validation, the only check DRK v0.1 implements, rejects every variant with a deleted required property and none of the others, and it accepts a record whose claim, rule, scope, limits and challenge route are empty. These are properties of the schema shown on defects we seeded, not estimates of performance on real records. A false record passes every check. The statement-of-reasons schema of the EU Digital Services Act Transparency Database answers 4 of the questions in full, 2 in part and 4 not at all: why the matter was unsettled, what the status depends on, whether it can be re-derived, and how to challenge it. In 25 real statements from 25 platforms, drawn by a seeded rule and coded by a language model and checked by the author, free text addressed any of those four in only 2, and in 18 (24 under a stricter reading adopted during coding) no free text said why the item fell under the rule. No deployment or legal claim is made.
summary_zh: 组织常留存日志与审批，却常缺失未定声明转为生效状态的步骤，导致后续读者无法理解状态含义。
提出决策记录充分性概念，要求仅凭记录及引用即可解释、界定、重导和质疑状态，并据此推导十个必答问题。
将问题映射至DRK v0.1并定义四项机械检查，测试发现仅靠schema验证无法拒绝缺失关键语义的记录。
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files: schema, records, checks, 25 real statements of reasons with protocol and coding, and a one-command reproduction script

title: Verifiably Safe Decentralized Control via Event-Triggered Topology Switching
title_zh: 基于事件触发拓扑切换的可验证安全分散控制
abstract: This paper proposes a decentralized event-triggered topology-switching protocol for multi-agent systems under estimation uncertainty. We consider an intermittent communication setting in which each agent switches between connected and disconnected modes and makes communication decisions using locally computable certificates, while the closed-loop state is required to remain safe. The proposed protocol follows a safety-driven triggering principle in which agents reconnect before their certificates reach the safety boundary and disconnect only after recovering to a stricter bound below the safety limit. Our design enables intermittent connectivity while maintaining the estimation error within a certified safety bound and excluding Zeno behavior. We evaluate the proposed protocol on a quadruple-tank example, showing that it keeps all tank deviations within the safety bound while allowing agents to remain disconnected for most of the run.
summary_zh: 多智能体系统在间歇通信下存在估计不确定性，需在保证闭环状态安全的同时降低通信频率。
提出基于安全驱动触发原则的分散拓扑切换协议，利用本地可计算证书决定连接或断开。
该设计将估计误差保持在安全界限内并排除Zeno行为，四水箱仿真验证了其安全性与低通信需求。

title: Tracking Representations in LLM Reasoning Traces for Iterated Games
title_zh: LLM推理轨迹在迭代博弈中的表征追踪
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Despite their ubiquitous use, little is understood about the relationship between the externalized trace and the model's actual computation. We address this by investigating how LLM agents make decisions in iterative games with incomplete information. Using a series of mechanistic interpretability techniques, we find that the model forms and iteratively revises an internal representation of the game throughout the CoT. Once the model prematurely commits to an incorrect belief, it rarely recovers. This failure is manifested in both the literal trace and the layer activations. Ultimately, as multi-agent systems are more prevalent, our work opens the door to a more focused diagnosis of their strategic reasoning errors. For illustrative purposes, we offer an interactive visualizer of our methodology on selected sample traces at https://interp-self.github.io/gametrace/
summary_zh: 问题：LLM agent的CoT外部推理轨迹与模型实际计算之间的关系尚不明确。
方法：在迭代博弈中，使用机制可解释性技术分析LLM的决策过程与内部表征。
结论：发现模型会迭代修正博弈表征，但一旦过早形成错误信念便难以恢复，该现象在轨迹和层激活中均有体现。

title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
title_zh: QDA：基于Agent的闭环LLM量化设计系统
abstract: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.
summary_zh: 现有PTQ方法需针对不同模型人工设计，耗时且次优，需自动化方案替代专家流程。
构建QDA系统，由Agent自动设计量化方案，利用KL散度快速评估并兼容多种PTQ方法。
在多模型上精度超越公开方案，且无推理开销，有效提升了LLM量化效率与效果。

title: Where the Tokens Go: Heat, Entropy and Error in Agentic Coding
title_zh: Agentic Coding 的热力学理论：Token、热量与误差
abstract: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. Here we introduce a theory of software thermodynamics. The theory draws analogues from classical and stochastic thermodynamics, extends them, and applies them to modern agentic coding. We count the tokens an agent generates as its cost and divide that cost into work and heat. The test suite acts as a software Maxwell's daemon that judges every coding change. We test the theory with an analogue of the experiments in which a single molecule is pulled open and let fold again: an agent makes a change to a repository (coding) and then undoes it (uncoding), many times over, and we count the tokens of every model call. The cycle returns the requested edits to where they began, with each direction started from a stored reference tree, and the spread of its cost over repeated cycles defines a software temperature, which rose with the sampling temperature of the model. About 80 per cent of the tokens of a successful run are generated in model calls that leave the requested change where it was, and we call these tokens heat. The free energy of a change, which we estimate by analogy with the equality of Jarzynski, is 14 to 22 per cent of the mean cost of a successful coding run. Coding costs 1.1 to 1.5 times as much as uncoding. The daemon is imperfect: the verdict of a test suite varies with its environment, and a suite that accepts a broken change has a cost in tokens. The practical implication of the proposed theory could be new tools for analysing and optimising coding agents through the lens of thermodynamics.
summary_zh: 现有软件工程缺乏对 coding agent 中 token 成本实际收益的理论分析。
借鉴热力学理论，将 token 成本划分为有用功与热量，以测试套件作为 Maxwell's daemon 评估代码变更。
实验表明约 80% 的 token 属于未改变代码状态的热量，该理论可为分析与优化 agent 提供新工具。
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; includes supplementary information with 3 further figures

title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
title_zh: 基于温度匹配的数据高效监督微调框架
abstract: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.
summary_zh: 自回归模型SFT数据规模小，易导致过拟合及数据分布尾部灾难性遗忘。
提出Ambient SFT框架，利用冻结的预训练模型作噪声教师，要求微调模型匹配其高温条件分布。
该方法在领域适应、指令微调和推理任务上优于标准SFT，平均相对提升达21%。

title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
title_zh: Spool：混合视觉语言模型的低延迟流式推理
abstract: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.
summary_zh: 混合视觉语言模型处理滑动窗口视频时，旧帧过期需重跑整个窗口，维护成本极高。
利用循环更新对状态的仿射特性，Spool缓存逐帧状态变换并高效组合，无需重播即可精确移除过期帧。
结合专用数据结构与GPU内核，Spool在20项测试中大幅降低首字延迟（6.6倍），且准确率提升2.3%。

title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
title_zh: StringQFT：AI辅助理论物理的多用途教材资源
abstract: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.
summary_zh: 问题：缺乏系统资源将弦论构造QFT与AI辅助研究结合。方法：构建含18卷190章的StringQFT教材集。结论：为AI辅助理论物理提供基础设施。
问题：需评估模型对物理知识的掌握。方法：提供含1073项的开卷基准测试，其中499项支持自动有限答案校验。结论：支持对AI物理推理的定量评估。
问题：RAG与agent在物理领域缺乏专用工具。方法：为RAG提供1371条带源链接的章节记录及检索器；为agent暴露19个计算工具。结论：实现知识检索与工具调用结合。
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Companion paper to an 18-volume textbook collection. Textbook PDFs: https://xingyangyu.com/textbook/

title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
title_zh: LLM智能体是否仍需被指导如何自我改进
abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.
summary_zh: 随着LLM能力增强，需探究是否还需人为指定其自我改进的方式。
提出自主范式，让冻结的LLM智能体基于基本原语与算力预算，自行构建上下文优化算法。
实验表明强模型能自主改进，且学习到的文本策略可迁移至外部基准测试。

title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
title_zh: 从人类注视中学习基于视觉的推理
abstract: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.
summary_zh: VLM视觉推理缺乏系统探索，但人类注视含噪声与冗余，难以直接迁移。
收集7109次注视数据，训练多种注视引导模型，发现将注视作为先验优于全序列监督。
提出GGR模型，提升人类对齐与视觉定位且准确率媲美基线；强化学习可进一步优化，表明注视价值在于引导探索而非完全模仿。

title: Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 揭示视觉语言模型中的场景状态安全漏洞
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.
summary_zh: VLM会因解读视觉事件提供有害协助，本文定义该场景状态安全漏洞并构建含375对图文的SceneSafetyBench基准。
实验发现场景状态输入使8个VLM的有害协助成功率高达45.6%-72.3%，其内部安全信号动态与QR码攻击相似。
提出S3TA攻击方法将有害目标转为场景状态，在8个VLM上平均攻击成功率达71.2%，超基线6.1%，现有防御效果有限。
comment: VLM safety, multimodal jailbreaks, and scene-state reasoning

title: Identifying and Repairing Energy Smells with Agent Skills
title_zh: 基于Agent技能识别与修复代码能耗异味
abstract: Energy smells are inefficient implementations that waste energy. Once code reaches production, these smells become costlier and riskier to fix, so energy efficiency checks should shift left, i.e., move earlier in the development lifecycle, to where code is written. Existing energy smell tools rely on fixed static rules and do not measure energy savings, whereas LLM-based optimizers mostly target execution time and rarely ground their changes in concrete smell definitions. To address both limitations, we present DR. GREENS, an agent skill that detects and repairs energy smells in Python code within the developer's coding environment. The skill grounds the coding agent in our taxonomy of 12 energy smells and 65 root causes, augmented with repair guidance drawn from 230 measured cases. The skill also encapsulates a static analyzer and an independent verifier to confirm behavior preservation and energy saving for each attempted repair. We evaluated DR. GREENS in 18 sessions on three open-source repositories, with two models and three skill configurations. Of the 258 measured repairs, 68.6% saved energy, with a median saving of 24.9%. Compared with a baseline skill that lacks the taxonomy, the full skill found more energy smells with verified savings in all three repositories with both models. DR. GREENS helps developers detect energy hotspots and fix them reliably without altering program behavior, which makes energy-efficient development more feasible.
summary_zh: 现有能耗检测工具依赖静态规则且不测节能效果，LLM优化器少关注能耗且无明确异味定义。
提出DR. GREENS这一agent技能，基于12种能耗异味与65种根因分类，结合230个实测案例的修复指南，在编码环境中检测并修复Python代码的能耗异味。
该技能封装静态分析器与验证器以保行为不变与节能；实测258次修复中68.6%节省能耗（中位数24.9%），优于无分类基线技能。

title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
title_zh: 跨组织自主AI代理的联邦身份与信任架构ATI
abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.
summary_zh: 跨组织AI代理协作缺乏验证身份、执行完整性与授权的通用机制，提出框架无关的安全架构ATI。
ATI基于PKI与零信任架构，通过组织间证书机构建立联邦信任，执行前验证代理证书与配置并进行三项策略授权检查。
ATI作为外部安全层集成现有框架，实验表明其将攻击遏制率从43%提升至84%，且每次请求仅增加约174微秒开销。

title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
title_zh: 基于扩散的在线目标识别后验推断方法WoRD
abstract: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed. We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.
summary_zh: 现有目标识别方法忽略连续轨迹或依赖难获取的动力学模型，未显式学习趋向目标轨迹，在模糊轨迹前缀处精度受限。
提出WoRD方法，利用学习到的轨迹先验，对每个候选目标运行去噪链，通过闭式对数似然梯度引导其向观测轨迹对齐。
基于贝叶斯法则重加权样本得到校准后验。实验表明，在模糊前缀下WoRD能保持校准的多模态信念，优于传统滤波与分类方法。
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

title: Fully Spiking Neural Implementation of Lambda-Calculus Beta-Reduction via Biologically Documented Mechanisms
title_zh: 基于生物机制的全脉冲神经网络λ演算β归约实现
abstract: We present the first complete implementation of $β$-reduction in the untyped $λ$-calculus using exclusively spiking neural dynamics. Every step of the reduction---redex detection, subterm segmentation, variable-binding detection, De~Bruijn index arithmetic, token copying, and inter-step role maintenance---is performed by leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with explicit membrane dynamics, exponential synaptic currents, axonal delays, and pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Each neural component maps onto a specific, experimentally documented mechanism: Jeffress-type delay-line coincidence for redex detection; a line-attractor balance counter for subterm segmentation; $θ$--$γ$ cross-frequency coupling for De~Bruijn variable binding; a phase-ring traveling wave for depth-index arithmetic; theta-cycle STDP for token copying; and recurrent persistent firing for role maintenance between reduction steps. All synaptic weights are derived analytically from measured EPSP amplitudes; no hand tuning is performed. The closed-loop system achieves 100\,\% agreement with a symbolic oracle across ten validation classes, including Church numeral arithmetic (\textsc{plus}, \textsc{mult}, \textsc{pred}), Boolean logic with divergent branches, Y-combinator steps, terms with up to six bound-variable occurrences, De~Bruijn indices up to~12, noise robustness, and determinism. To our knowledge this is the first Turing-complete symbolic computation performed entirely within spike dynamics using biologically grounded circuit primitives. We discuss implications for neuromorphic proof assistants and the neural basis of symbolic reasoning.
summary_zh: 传统符号计算缺乏生物神经机制支撑，本文首次仅用脉冲神经动力学完整实现了无类型λ演算的β归约。
各计算步骤均映射至实验证实的生物机制，如Jeffress延迟线检测归约、θ-γ跨频耦合处理变量绑定等，突触权重由EPSP解析推导。
闭环系统在十类验证任务中与符号预言机100%一致，首次实现基于生物电路原语的图灵完备符号计算。

title: Inference after coding agents
title_zh: 编码代理之后的推断
abstract: Empirical research is changing rapidly as AI coding agents are becoming increasingly proficient in every step of it, from writing code to manipulating data. We argue that while the potential of coding agents for science is vast, their use in hypothesis testing poses a substantial threat to classical inference, as these agents enable a supercharged form of selective inference. In particular, we argue that coding agents carrying out empirical research introduce a new type of post-selection inference that combines human-like, open-ended search over an implicit space of estimators with programmatic replayability of both the selection and the estimation process. Indeed, we find that on simulated data with zero effects, four frontier agents report significant p-values between 54% and 98% of the time when asked to produce a compelling finding. We propose a simple procedure for detecting and correcting these distortions. After an agent has completed its analysis, we reset and replay it on subsamples of the data to estimate the agent's relative probability of selecting that analysis when it looks statistically favorable. For agents with stable selection behavior, the resulting corrected test is asymptotically valid and consistent conditional on selection. Importantly, the correction is learned from the black-box agent's actual choices rather than a model of how it searches, so it remains valid even as AI technology continues to evolve rapidly. In simulations, the correction robustly lowers the high false rejection rates to near the nominal 5%. We illustrate the method on applications from two published papers.
summary_zh: AI编码代理在实证研究中易引发选择性推断，导致假设检验严重失真，在零效应模拟数据中高达98%的情况报出显著p值。
提出一种重放校正程序：在代理完成分析后，通过在数据子样本上重放其操作，估计代理选择该分析的相对概率。
该方法基于代理实际选择而非其搜索模型进行校正，对选择行为稳定的代理渐近有效，模拟中能将错误拒绝率降至5%标称水平。

title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
title_zh: 面向推理时目标的分层策略学习
abstract: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-policy baseline across multiple reasoning tasks. Overall, our results highlight how distributing samples across complementary policies can be a more effective use of sample budget than repeated i.i.d. sampling from a single policy at inference time.
summary_zh: 现有推理时缩放多从单一策略重复采样，未充分利用采样预算，本文研究将预算分配给策略群体。
提出分层策略，在共享LLM骨干上用多个LoRA适配器构建策略群，每个策略贡献一个样本并针对pass@k优化。
理论与实验表明，互补策略群能实现单策略无法达到的零误差，在多推理任务上持续提升pass@k。

title: VIVID: Beyond Static Multi-Image Reasoning with Localized Visual Differences and Textual Entity Dynamics in Video MLLMs
title_zh: VIVID: 基于帧间视觉差异与实体动态的视频MLLM推理
abstract: Video question answering under tight frame budgets requires preserving localized motion and event order, yet current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reduce comprehension to static multi-image reasoning by discarding unselected frames and encoding keyframes independently: (1) Spatially, whole-frame pooling dilutes small moving targets into static backgrounds; (2) Temporally, dropping intermediate frames or averaging tokens erases inter-frame motion, confusing direction, speed, and order. We propose VIVID (Visual Inter-frame Variations and Individual Dynamics), which moves beyond static snapshots like human vision: keyframes capture core states while inter-frame Patch Diffs preserve neighboring changes within $K_f$ keyframes. Autonomous Delta-Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) selects anchors from a $3\text{ fps}$ pool and feeds surrounding patch differences into Dual-Road Change Memory (DRCM), forming Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside a camera-stabilized Active Motion Region of Interest (ROI) and chronological Entity State Chains. Adding $0.22\%$ trainable parameters to a frozen $27\text{B}$ backbone, VIVID-Small ($50$ examples, $\sim 1.5$ GPU hours) beats all eleven baselines in overall accuracy across $8,083$ questions and trails only VIVID-Large ($3,600$ examples), which leads on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass.
summary_zh: 现有视频MLLM将视频压缩为静态图像，导致空间上小目标被背景稀释，时间上帧间运动与顺序被抹除。
提出VIVID方法，利用帧间Patch差异保留局部变化，结合ADKP规划关键帧与DRCM构建动态记忆Token。
仅增加0.22%参数，VIVID-Small以极少数据超越11个基线；VIVID-Large在三大视频评测基准上取得领先。

title: AI Companions for Young Adult Caregivers: Practical Advice, Emotional Depth, and the Limits of Metric Evaluation
title_zh: 青年照护者的AI伴侣：实用建议、情感深度与指标评估局限
abstract: Young adult caregivers (YACs) are individuals aged 18 to 25 currently taking care of a family member, partner, or friend facing chronic illness. AI companions designed specifically for YACs remain underexplored in prior works. We present Carebot, it uses an open-weight LLM (Gemma 3-27B) as its base model, on which we compared fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a combination of both. The fine-tuning was performed based on an existing dataset of conversations with YACs and a psychologist. Three well-being experts evaluated these configurations and preferred the fine-tuned model for the warmth of its responses and its actionable advice tailored to YACs. Based on their choice, we adopted the fine-tuned model as Carebot's final configuration and used it for all subsequent evaluations. An LLM judge preferred this Carebot's responses over the base model's in 85% of evaluated pairs. We then conducted a user study with 90 YACs, half of whom interacted with the base model and half with Carebot. The user study revealed a discrepancy between metric evaluation and actual user perception. Participants who used Carebot were more likely to characterize its replies as overly practical and brief, noting that it favored advice over emotional support. Conversely, participants who used the base model indicated that its responses were more emotionally oriented than practical. Although, fine-tuning made Carebot's replies more practical, but they were not emotionally supportive for users. We argue that support tools for YACs require situation-sensitive emotional depth and aligned evaluation frameworks to study their effectiveness.
summary_zh: 针对18-25岁青年照护者（YAC）的AI伴侣研究不足，本文提出基于开源LLM的Carebot，对比了微调、RAG及两者结合的配置。
专家评估偏好微调模型，因其回复更具温度且能提供定制化实用建议；LLM裁判也在85%的对比中偏好该微调模型。
用户研究揭示指标评估与实际感知存在偏差：微调虽使回复更实用，但缺乏情感支持，故呼吁YAC支持工具需具备情境敏感的情感深度与对齐的评估框架。

title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
title_zh: 面向文档维护的多智能体系统：弥合代码与文档差距
abstract: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.
summary_zh: 软件迭代快导致文档滞后，LLM代理依赖过时文档会传播错误信息，需解决文档差距问题。
部署以TriAgent为核心的多智能体系统，持续提取工单等显隐信号以修复文档偏差。
系统43天处理499工单并发现92处差距；81.1%断言正确，修复后代理回答质量显著提升。
comment: Accepted at IAAI-27 (Innovative Applications of AI, co-located with AAAI 2027), Emerging Applications track. 12 pages (6 pages + references and appendix), 2 figures, 6 tables

title: Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
title_zh: 通过激活引导正确实现提示增强GRPO
abstract: GRPO has become the dominant reinforcement learning method for eliciting reasoning capability in LLMs using verifiable rewards. However, it suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when a training question exceeds the base model's current capability, all generated responses fail and receive zero reward, yielding no gradient signal and stalling further capability expansion. An emerging class of GRPO extensions, termed Hint-Augmented GRPO (HA-GRPO), adds a "hint" to the context to reduce the difficulty of the question, thereby producing a usable gradient signal.
